Zone.Name: Catwalk and Cavern areas of Tynstri

Rooms.Name: End of the Catwalk
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on a very tiny platform at one end of a long
catwalk.  Looking around you, you can see a vast network of narrow rope
and vine bridges and ladders. The rope bridges are delicately made and
seem to blend naturally into their surroundings.  The catwalk continues
north, or you might be able to climb up a bit.

Exits.Description: The catwalk stretches on ahead of you, inviting you to explore.
You see a tangle of leaves and branches above you.

Rooms.Name: Catwalk Intersection
Rooms.Description:
The catwalk branches east, north and south at this point.    This
section of the walkway is firmly attached to the tree to your west, and
you examine it closely to see if there is a pathway down to terra firma
from here!  The air is very still around you, and you wonder if the
elves and fairies who live in these trees are asleep or merely hidden
from you.

Exits.Description: The catwalk winds among the trees.
The catwalk branches east from here.
You can see one end of the catwalk to the south.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is a large tree of a type unknown to you.  It is, fortunately,
large enough to support this section of the walkway.

Rooms.Name: Catwalk in the Trees
Rooms.Description:
It is understandable why a catwalk is called a catwalk.  Only someone
as light on its feet as a cat would feel safe here.  The narrow bridge
made from vines and small branches sways with the slightest breeze,
making you uncomfortably aware that your combat gear makes you less
than sure-footed.  You grip each tree that you pass, looking for a way
down, but so far the trees have been remarkably bare of lower branches.

Exits.Description: A huge gray tree with some carving, and a faint orange glow.
You see an intersection in 2 catwalks.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks shaky.

Rooms.Name: A Catwalk Ends
Rooms.Description:
This small platform is actually carved into the wood of an enormous
tree of a variety you have never seen.  The bark is silver gray and
quite thick, and has been carved by a master's hand with delicate
frescoes of fairies in flight.  There are signs the tree has been
recently singed by fire.  Above the fairies you see in the fresco huge,
vicious winged creatures with sharply hooked beaks and long talons...

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The critters look like dragons.

Rooms.Name: Along the Catwalk, Between Trees
Rooms.Description:
This is a long, unsupported section of the catwalk.  The rope and 
vine bridge sways wildly between the trees, and you try not to look
down as you think of things to occupy your mind while you traverse the 
section.  How many steps till the next tree ...  which is closer, the 
one east or the one west...  Are those wings you hear?

Exits.Description: You see what looks like a fairly secure resting-place.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

Rooms.Name: Temporary Safety Among the Trees
Rooms.Description:
You are at the eastern end of the longest stretch of unsupported,
narrow, flimsy, wimpy-looking catwalk you ever hope to see.  What were
you thinking climbing up here in the first place?  Where can you get
back down to earth?  What is that nasty-looking
bat-kind-of-but-not-quite creature headed for you outta the sky?  Your
choices from here?  Heading north on that wide limb or south on the
catwalk.

Exits.Description: An apparently short spike of the catwalk heads north.
The wobbly catwalk continues south.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

Rooms.Name: Out on a Limb
Rooms.Description:
The view from here is fairly okay, if you like heights.  You can see
another portion of the catwalk twisting off to the east and a huge,
strange silvery tree blocks the view to the west.  It is unlike any
tree you have seen before, and you wonder if the tales you heard at
Barns & Nibble of fairy folk and giant dragons have any truth to them.
You may return to your walk on the wild side by heading south.

Exits.Description: The catwalk resumes south of here.

Rooms.Name: A Walk on the Wild Side
Rooms.Description:
You try to act cool, hummin "doo doo-doo doot doo doo doooooo" as
you stroll along the catwalk, hoping those AWFULLY BIG birdlike critters
have eaten recently.  You can see them, way above you, circling like
you've heard vultures do when they've found something good to eat.
You could go north or east from here.  You hope the birds are just
making lazy circles in the sky ... for exercise!

Exits.Description: The platform looks fairly safe.
The catwalk continues.

Rooms.Name: Turning Twisting Catwalk
Rooms.Description:
The catwalk must turn and twist as it wraps its way around the
trees.  This particular section looks newer.  The vine is greener,
softer, laced with mistletoe.  Mistletoe, you remember, strengthens
magical enchantments. Perhaps that is the source of the strength of the
seemingly fragile walkway.

Exits.Description: There seems to be a lot more mistletoe in that direction.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

Rooms.Name: Mistletoe Path
Rooms.Description:
There is quite a bit of mistletoe along this section of the catwalk.
The dark green leaves and waxy white berries make the pedestrian
walkway look enchanted, as indeed it is.  You wonder about the quantity
of mistletoe on this stretch.  Is there some special purpose other than
keeping the catwalk together and properly suspended?  You continue on
your way, either north or south from here.

Exits.Description: The path through the trees continues.
The path through the trees continues.

Rooms.Name: The Path Pivots
Rooms.Description:
After attaching itself to another large tree of indeterminable
species, the path meanders east and south from this point.  The southern 
route looks laced with mistletoe, the path east looks more ordinary.
The normal soft forest sounds of chirping birds, scurrying small animals
and rustling leaves surround you.  Occasionally you think you hear the
beat of heavy wings and a strange down draft, but you put that down to
your overactive imagination.

Exits.Description: The path through the trees continues.
The path through the trees continues.

Rooms.Name: Standing at the Crossroads
Rooms.Description:
Your choices are many here - up to a fire lookout, south to what
looks remarkably like a doorstep, or east or west along a more 
indeterminate route.  You don't see any means of climbing down, so you 
must continue on as best you can.  Occasionally you believe you hear 
the rush of large wings, then shake your head in disbelief..

Exits.Description: The path continues for a short distance.
The path continues for a short distance.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.
It looks hot.

Rooms.Name: The Element of Fire
Rooms.Description:
Living in the woods, the Elves must always be cautious of fire, and
you can see that here, at a lookout, someone has made some magic to 
protect the elven group.  Stones of hematite, beryl, citrine, jasper and 
ruby are arranged here in a careful pattern, calling forth a powerful 
magic to protect the trees.

Exits.Description: The path continues for a short distance.

Rooms.Name: Henrietta's Doorstep
Rooms.Description:
You are standing outside a door cleverly carved into the huge oak
tree to the east of you.  The ridges and knotholes that are part of this
tree all but hide the entrance, or they would if it weren't for the
little sign proclaiming "Humble Henrietta's Handy Herbs Here".  If you
decide not to visit Henrietta, the catwalk leads back to the north.

Exits.Description: It looks like a crossroads of sorts.
It looks like a knotty tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like there may be something stuffed inside.

It was once a naughty dragon.  Henrietta the Mighty ensorcelled it, and
now it is simply a knotty tree.

Rooms.Name: Henrietta's
Rooms.Description:
You enter a cheery little kitchen, with cheerful yellow curtains
over the sunny windows and a red and white checked cloth on the table.  
This is Henrietta's workshop, her kitchen for cooking up powerful
concoctions that keep the elves strong and resilient.  Henrietta has
lived here ever since her apprenticeship as a child of 83.  She is a
strong and powerful woman, friendly to strangers.  There is a small
sign on the wall.

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It reads,
                              Do not meddle
                        in the affairs of wizards        
                           for you are crunchy 
                      and go well with Grey Poupon.

Rooms.Name: Along the Catwalk
Rooms.Description:
As you walk along the catwalk, you marvel at this example of elven
engineering.  With minimal support from the tall trees surrounding it,
the narrow vine catwalk has become the elevated highway of Tynstri,
allowing its children to play outside in the fresh air without fear of
the dangers that strangers bring to the village below.  There is a
small sign attached to the vine, which serves as a handrail.

Exits.Description: The catwalk continues on for a small distance.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

Rooms.Name: A Change in Direction
Rooms.Description:
The catwalk changes direction here as if abruptly defining the
limits of the upper village.  The view from here is breathtaking, open 
as it is to the north and west, overlooking mountain and trees with no 
signs of any attempts to tame nature.  The elf king's consort is fond of
saying the best of sunsets are to be seen from the treetops of Tynstri.

Exits.Description: The trees are very green and welcoming.
The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

Rooms.Name: Walking the Catwalk
Rooms.Description:
The catwalk is responsive beneath your weight, moving almost as if
it were alive.  All around you the forest is green and swaying and
beautiful.  If you weren't so afraid of falling you would feel a lot
better.  Off in the distance you see what looks like a bright purple
blot against the sky and it seems to be moving towards you!  Your
escape lies either up or south or east.  Pick one and RUN!

Exits.Description: The catwalk appears to bend north of here.
It looks like a small platform surrounded by trees.
A strong vine ladder leads up.

Rooms.Name: Surrounded by trees
Rooms.Description:
You are surrounded by trees - elder to protect you from negative
spirits, hawthorn (witches' tree) and oak.  The small platform creaks
gently under your feet, and if you look down, you can see it rests on
the top of one of the beautiful arches of the Wiccan monastery below.
It might be possible to climb out over the edge of the platform, wrap
arms and legs tightly around the arch, and slide awkwardly down to the
ground below.

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.
There is a way down... look out.

Rooms.Name: Another Decision Point on the Catwalk
Rooms.Description:
You stand at a catwalk crossroads, your choices from here are down,
south or west.  From where you stand, you can see little to choose
between them.  You are tempted to ask a passerby, but there don't
appear to be many, at least none who are very responsive to a polite
question.

Exits.Description: Another turn in the catwalk.
A turning point in the catwalk.
You COULD try to e_a_s_e your way down the vine ladder.

Rooms.Name: One Last Turn
Rooms.Description:
You can see the lovely catwalk ending in a small watch-place to the
east, and the path continues north for quite some distance.  You rest a
moment here, wondering yet again about the variety and numbers of trees
that surround you.

Exits.Description: The catwalk continues for a short distance.
There is a cul de sac to the east.

Rooms.Name: Cul de sac
Rooms.Description:
The catwalk ends here on a large platform looking out on the
beautiful lake to the south.  This is evidently a place where early 
morning ceremonies are held to greet the sun, or perhaps just a sunny 
spot for morning exercise.

Exits.Description: The green vines of the catwalk blend into the trees to the west.

Rooms.Name: A Turning Point
Rooms.Description:
The catwalk branches east and south here, and you are standing on a
small platform firmly attached to what appears to be an oak tree.
Occasionally you see an elf heading home or out for an adventure, but
mostly the forest is quiet.    You wonder what lies ahead.

Exits.Description: There appears to be a ladder attached to a tree.
The catwalk continues ...

Rooms.Name: A Long Walk above the Forest Floor
Rooms.Description:
You are treading softly on a long stretch of delicately wrought
catwalk.  Looking closely at the swaying bridge was a mistake, as it
showed you how much the bridge had worn away in time.  You wonder
should you take off your heavy boots with the sharp cleats on them, and
wish you hadn't decided to carry quite so much with you.

Exits.Description: There is a turn in the catwalk to the north.
The catwalk appears to come to a dead end unlike, you hope, yourself.

Rooms.Name: Another Dead End
Rooms.Description:
You have reached what appears to be another dead end after a long
long time spent up on the catwalk.  There are doors to the west and 
south, and the view to the east is magnificent, of mountains and 
enchanted forests.

Exits.Description: There is a fragile catwalk stretching northwards.
A door painted with a pattern of leaves leads south.
An ornately carved oak door.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The door south appears to be covered with spring leaves.

Rooms.Name: A Watchroom
Rooms.Description:
You enter a comfortable room carved into a huge oak tree.  There are
wide windows facing west to the sunset, overlooking the town.  A large
sofa made from some unusual black leather graces the room. Chairs
carved of oak provide seating, and storybook pictures add color and
charm to an otherwise somber room.  You realize you have stumbled into
someone's parlor and you should probably leave by the door to the east.

Exits.Description: There is a small platform just outside.

Rooms.Name: Annie's Room
Rooms.Description:
A bedroom for an elven princess ... this one in particular
apparently loves being outdoors.  Two walls are made of sliding slatted 
doors and lead to the verandah that surrounds her room. The other walls 
are filled with pictures of wolves, books of wolf lore and posters
declaring "Free the Elves".  The ceiling is covered with faintly
glowing stars.  Sitting atop the bed is a very large, stuffed purple
dragon.  What is that you see peeking out from underneath her tall bed?
*shudder*  You can go west to visit her closet (a very scary place in
itself) or north to the catwalk.

Exits.Description: You see a leaf-covered door
Annie's closet is this way.

Rooms.Name: Annie's Closet
Rooms.Description:
Annie's closet is piled high with the discarded gear of her many
sisters.  It is amazing that such a small room could hold so much ...
stuff!  Leggings lie tumbled next to headbands, scepters lean against
corners next to spears and bows.  A #ys#wh#yi#wn#yi#wn#wg#N hammer sits
glowing quietly on a high closet shelf while combat boots and hooves
sit side-by-side on the floor.  Annie generally throws equipment in
here quickly without looking.  Not, of course, because she is afraid of
monsters-who-live-in-the-dark . . . !

Rooms.Name: Tightly spiraling staircase
Rooms.Description:
This staircase winds tightly upwards with barely enough room for your
body to traverse it.  It is very dark in here, and very quiet.

Exits.Description: It's dark down there!
It's dark up there!

Rooms.Name: Tightly winding staircase
Rooms.Description:
This staircase appears to be carved from the inside of a tree.  You
turn around and around, getting dizzier and dizzier as you go.  You
would hate to meet an enemy here.  There isn't even enough room for you
to draw a weapon!

Exits.Description: It's dark up there!
It's dark down there!

Rooms.Name: Elfking's Home
Rooms.Description:
Here is where you will find the elf king when he is not away on a
crusade to combat evil.  The walls are hung with richly colored
tapestries telling of ancient elven heroes.  Young elven children
(under 50 years old) are brought here to learn of their glorious
history.  The good king rules over his forest kingdom from an ornately
carved, shiny golden throne.  The seat looks a bit hard ... perhaps
that has something to do with his frequent absences.  In his absence
the awesome Master Ranger roams the forest, protecting his subjects,
and his Honor Guard remains here, protecting the throne.

Exits.Description: A magnificent public entrance
It looks dark and narrow.

Rooms.Name: On the eastern side of a very large tree
Rooms.Description:
You are perched precariously on a wide branch in a very large tree.
The tree is covered with a rough, dark bark that tears into your
fingers as you cling to it for balance.  Occasionally a large piece
breaks off in your hands and you rapidly grab for purchase.  Around
you, the forest is filled with the noise of birds and small and
not-so-small animals going about their normal daily activities.  Below
you there appears to be some sort of bridge between trees.  You can
climb down to the bridge or around the tree to the west.

Exits.Description:
The tree has many strong branches.  You could use them like stepping
stones.

Looks like a bridge.  If you are strong, you could grab the branch you
are standing on and swing yourself down.

Rooms.Name: On one of several sturdy branches
Rooms.Description:
You are standing on one of several sturdy branches high up on the
west side of an enormous tree.  You can see off to the west a sturdy 
tree with a ladder going down, but there appears to be no means of 
getting there.  The tree which is supporting you is enormous.  It is so 
big around that even leaning way out from the trunk, you are unable to 
see the eastern side.  There are many large, thick branches, however 
that you might use to climb around the tree to the other side.  Your 
only other option appears to be a swan dive to the ground.

Exits.Description: Many strong branches.

Rooms.Name: The Grand Staircase
Rooms.Description:
Managing to look at once quite grand, yet perfectly at home in the
tiny village park, a grand marble staircase rises eastward.  Although 
each golden marble step is shallow, there are many hundreds leading 
upwards.  As you crane your neck to look up, you can see no end to the 
steps.  Perhaps this is an illusion?  Yet the steps feel firm beneath 
your feet.  West from here lies the village park.

Exits.Description: The staircase continues upwards for as far as you can see.
The village park.

Rooms.Name: Public Entrance to the Throne Room
Rooms.Description:
Perched at the top of an elegant but endless gold and white marble
staircase, the public entrance to the Elf King's home blends perfectly
into its setting in the trees.  The grand columns supporting the roof
are, in fact, living trees.  From this vantage point you can see much
of Tynstri.  The small monastery is still east of you, the village
shops are to the west, and there are large forest areas north and south 
of you.  From here, the throne room is just to the north and the village
lies at the bottom of the steps at your feet.

Exits.Description:
The Elf King welcomes you to his home.  Please wipe your feet before
entering.
It's a l-o-o-o-o-o-ng way down.

Rooms.Name: At the base of a very large tree
Rooms.Description:
A slight trail through the forest ends here at the base of a very
tall, very thick tree.  The village park for Tynstri is south of here 
and you may wish to head there. The other choice here is to follow the 
faint trail through the deep forest going east.

Exits.Description: You see a faint trail leading east.
A somewhat seedy looking park

Rooms.Name: A Faint Trail
Rooms.Description:
A faint trail leads through towering trees.  The forest is alive
around you.  You can almost hear the trees growing, feel the sizzling 
magic in the air.  From here, the path leads northwards for a spell, 
or east into a tangle of leaves.

Exits.Description: The path continues.
You could probably squeeze in between the two trees.
There is a huge tree looming west of you.

Rooms.Name: A Space Between Two Trees
Rooms.Description:
There is a small space here between two enormous trees.  The ground
is flat, and the thin grasses growing there have been squashed by
something quite heavy.  The only exit lies west.

Exits.Description: A faint trail

Rooms.Name: A clear path
Rooms.Description:
The path is more clearly marked here, and apparently well-traveled.
The vegetation is dense and healthy on both sides of the path, which
continues east, north and south.  It looks green and foresty in all
directions.

Exits.Description: The path turns sharply north of here.
The path continues clearly to the east.
The path appears to come to a turning point south of here.

Rooms.Name: Turning in the Path
Rooms.Description:
The path turns here rather sharply.  To the west there appears to be
a small open space and you can hear the faint sounds of a woodcutter's
axe.  To the south, the trail has more definition.

Exits.Description: The path looks more well-traveled.
You see more trees.

Rooms.Name: The Woodcutter's spot
Rooms.Description:
This clearing is clearly the work of some busy dwarven woodcutters.
The wood of this forest is known for its strength and magical
qualities.  It is a bit unpredictable.  That is, there are rumors of
trees attacking those who would cut them.  But that doesn't seem to
stop the dwarves who come here in search of good wood.

Exits.Description: There is a slight path leading east.

Rooms.Name: Forest Network
Rooms.Description:
From here the forest seems to be a network of trails.  Some are well
defined, some are faint.  In the dirt you can see some large
footprints.  They look roughly human, but much larger.  Caught on twigs
of a nearby bush you can see a tuft of fur shed by a wolf.  It is
impossible to tell how long it has been there, but you find yourself
listening intently to the forest sounds.

Exits.Description: Looks like the path takes another twist north.
You see some bushes.
The network of paths continues west.

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the Den
Rooms.Description:
You stand under a low outcropping of rock, which forms what appears
to be the entrance to a shallow cave.  From the dirt and leaves beneath
your feet, it appears this is the entrance to a wolf den.  The den
continues down a steep slope under the rock.  You will need to crawl to
get any further in that direction.

Exits.Description: The path west is blocked by bushes.
The wolf den.

Rooms.Name: Wolf Den West
Rooms.Description:
The roof of the cave hangs low over your head, forcing you to crawl
through this area.  Besides the discomfort, it leaves you at a distinct
disadvantage should you come upon any of the residents of this den.
The den cave gets a bit roomier to the east.

Exits.Description: The wolf den continues.

Rooms.Name: Wolf Den
Rooms.Description:
A few bones of undeterminable origin are scattered in this, the
roomiest part of the wolves' den.  Although the roof of the cave is too
low to allow you to stand upright, it is considerably higher than it is
either to the east or the west of here, where the den continues.

Exits.Description: The roof lowers sharply.
The roof lowers sharply as the cave continues.
Up a steep slope, you can see the entrance to the wolf cave.

Rooms.Name: Wolf Den East
Rooms.Description:
Even the wolf cubs must crouch to enter this part of their den.  The
rough stone walls encase you like a very uncomfortable coffin.  You can
crawl back to the larger part of the den to the west, probably the best
idea, or slither on your belly through the narrow crack in the rock
leading down into darkness.

Exits.Description: The scents and sights of the den come from the west.
It's hard to see anything, but the smell is pretty gruesome.

Rooms.Name: Another turn in the path
Rooms.Description:
The well-marked trail through the woods begins a steady slow descent
to the east.  There is a slight smell of charcoal and woodsmoke in the 
air here, and the path has become fairly wide.  To the south there 
appears to be an intersection between this path and another.

Exits.Description: A slow descent down a hill.
An intersection of paths.

Rooms.Name: At the top of a hill
Rooms.Description:
The trees have thinned out very slightly here, but enough that you
can see the gradual slope of a hill eastwards.  The forest floor is
sparsely covered with small flowers and grasses.  The light is dim
here, filtered by a dense covering of leaves high above you.

Exits.Description: To the west you see another turn in the path.
The path eastwards leads down a gentle slope.

Rooms.Name: Yet another ending
Rooms.Description:
What looked like a promising path through the trees has very quickly
fizzled into nothing.  You are surrounded by tall trees and an intense
quiet.  The trees to the west, north and east seem to huddle together
to keep you away.  The path south is open for you to take.

Exits.Description: The path thickens.

Rooms.Name: On a gradually sloping hill
Rooms.Description:
Surrounded by thorn bushes to the north and south, the forest seems
to be pushing you down the hill to the east.  Moving west would require 
a hard climb.  To the east, however, the stench of sulfur and fire seems
stronger.

Exits.Description: The hill slopes gently east.
It's uphill all the way.

Rooms.Name: Faint sounds of merriment
Rooms.Description:
From the north you can hear faint but unmistakable noises of
laughter and singing.  The path north heads up a steep slope.  The main 
path runs east-west here.

Exits.Description: The wide path continues.
Sounds of laughter and music.
Sure looks dark down there.

Rooms.Name: Downhill from fun
Rooms.Description:
The path through the trees has narrowed once again.  Uphill from
here, you hear voices singing and the thrumm of a tambourine, the click 
of finger cymbals.  Downhill, you can see a more well-defined, wider 
path.  The small path you are on also branches west.

Exits.Description: The faint path becomes fainter as you head west.
You hear the sounds of an elven encampment.
A broad path makes its way through the forest.

Rooms.Name: Amidst the maples
Rooms.Description:
You follow the faint path between tall maple trees.  The unusual
clustering of these trees gives the impression they were planted by a
hand more orderly than nature's.  The path continues north for a short
distance and to the east the path looks a bit more traveled.

Exits.Description: A small glade.
A path up a steep hill

Rooms.Name: A small glade
Rooms.Description:
A small but lovely break in the trees has been created here by the
woodcutter's axe.  This borders of this area are formed by different
varieties of maple.  It is a lovely place to be in the fall.  The only
path out leads south.

Exits.Description: The path takes a sharp turn

Rooms.Name: Elven encampment
Rooms.Description:
A small group of wood elves have set up camp here recently.  Known
for their great joy in life and fondness for good song and good stories,
the wood elves are more relaxed than many of their more noble-seeming
cousins.  The encampment continues to the north and east of here.

Exits.Description: The elven encampment
The elven encampment
Down the steep hill towards a broader path

Rooms.Name: A circle of fire
Rooms.Description:
An enticing circle of flame invites you to sit and relax.  What
could be dangerous in the deep forests of Tynstri?  The elves have told 
you stories of large numbers of dragons who live near here, but surely
those are just stories.  When you finish your stay at this encampment,
you can return by the path to the west.

Exits.Description: The western way

Rooms.Name: A merry time was had by all
Rooms.Description:
Surrounded by maple and birch, the wood elves have extended their
camp in this lovely clear space in the woods.  The forest floor is hard
beneath your feet, and there is a chill in the air that is not entirely
due to the weather or the general forest gloom.  You may leave this
spot by heading south down the hill.

Exits.Description: It's all downhill from here!

Rooms.Name: White birch path
Rooms.Description:
White birch and blue spruce line this part of the path, alternating
like some strange flag.  The stench of dragon breath and the heat of
dragon fires are strong here.  You must be near the source.  The path
westwards is uphill, and you are looking for a cave entrance.  The path
east looks promising, as the trees seem to have been thinned.  The path
south leads steeply down, though, to a cave mouth.  That must be it!

Exits.Description: The birch and spruce seem thinner
A broad path, well-trampled
The path down and south leads to a dark cave.  Do you have a lantern?

Rooms.Name: Neatly cut stumps
Rooms.Description:
From the neatly cut stumps of oak and maple, it's clear that a band
of woodcutters have been through here.  The critters who used to dwell 
in the branches of those trees have been evicted to find shelter
elsewhere.  The path continues north and west from here.

Exits.Description: The stumps continue
A gloom seems to settle over the path

Rooms.Name: Stumping along
Rooms.Description:
A stack of logs lies here waiting to be carted off to a sawmill.
For quite a distance in all directions there is nothing but short tree
stumps, a few of which still bleed.  You may leave this sad place to
the south.

Exits.Description: A faint path through thinning woods.

Rooms.Name: The Mouth
Rooms.Description:
You are standing at the mouth of a long tunnel leading deep into the
earth.  It is very dark and forbidding.  The air is fetid, damp, with a
faint sulphurous odor.  You may descend into who-knows-what, head west
to reconnoiter, or head up the hill.

Exits.Description: A small area to sit and think
Up the hill to deep forest
A long, dark, forbidding tunnel

Rooms.Name: A place to think
Rooms.Description:
A quiet little space to the west of the entrance to a very large
(and very dark and smelly) cave is a good place for a picnic, or to 
simply stop and think about your options.  Are you safer facing the 
gobble-uns of the forest or the dragons who surely must populate the 
cave?

Exits.Description: The cavemouth is ready to eat you up.

Rooms.Name: Dragon exit tunnel
Rooms.Description:
A long tunnel leads steadily upwards into fresh air.  To the west, a
rough passage slopes rapidly down a long passageway.  It is difficult
to see anything in any direction due to the slant of the tunnel.

Exits.Description: Fresh air seems to be coming to you from a distance
There is too much of an angle to see much of anything.

Rooms.Name: Kerbumpety thump
Rooms.Description:
As you bump your way down the slope you begin to worry you will be
unable to scramble back up again should you need to leave in a hurry.
Your nostrils fill with the definite, clear stench of dragon breath.
Lots of dragons.  You can TRY to head up the sloping tunnel or you can
kerbumpety thump your way west.

Exits.Description: Can't see much
Can't see much

Rooms.Name: All growed up
Rooms.Description:
Or almost all growed up dragons find their way out this exit and the
larger one which is up the slope from here.  From this spot you catch a
whiff of werewolf up a very small tunnel, but it's difficult to sort
that odor out over the overwhelming scent of dragon.

Exits.Description: The narrow tunnel continues up
The scent of wolf is faintly discernible.
A well lit corridor

Rooms.Name: Dragon Queen's doorstep
Rooms.Description:
Standing at the northern end of the long north-south hallway that
forms a large part of the dragon living quarters, you are awed by the 
size and grandeur of the caverns.  Although the roof towers high above 
you, it has been beautifully smoothed, and it glows of its own accord,
bathing the quarters in a soft light.  A sign on the gilt door to the
north reads, "Dragin Kween's hom"

Exits.Description: There is an elaborate gilt door
The well-lit corridor continues.
A dark and narrow tunnel.  Looks forbidding.

Rooms.Name: Dragon Kitchen
Rooms.Description:
Neatly kept and well-stocked, the elf slaves who work here have made
the best of their captivity.  The excellence of their cooking has made
them favorites of the dragon children as well as the queen, and their
every wish is granted.  Every one except for freedom.  The entrance to
the QueEn's quarters is east of here.

Exits.Description: QueEn's quarters' entrance

Rooms.Name: Entrance to the DraGoN QueEn's home
Rooms.Description:
An expensively furnished (if somewhat tacky) entrance room, this is
where visitors to her majesty must wait to be heard. The carpet is a
deep crimson, and the walls a deep violet.  There are two massive plush
velvet sofas placed facing each other in the center of the room.  One
is fuchsia, the other a deep purple. There is a wide space between the
seat of the sofa and the backrest, presumably to allow dragging tails
room to hang over the back edge.  Round stools of plush velvet are
scattered like bright pink polka dots around the room.

Exits.Description: The room of consorts
A gilt door leads into the hatchlings area
A heavy oak swinging door leads west to the kitchen

Rooms.Name: The room of consorts
Rooms.Description:
The queen's many consorts sit in this lovely room, waiting on her
pleasure.  They preen in the many mirrors and play games amongst
themselves to prove individual superiority.  They are always listening
for a call from their queen, whose rooms are west of here.

Exits.Description: A waiting room
QueEn's chambers

Rooms.Name: The lair of the DraGon QueEn
Rooms.Description:
Red velvet softens the walls and dims the magic glow, which is quite
strong here.  The queen is not fond of being closely observed.  She
rarely leaves her lair, preferring for her subjects to be brought to
her.

Exits.Description: The consort room

Rooms.Name: Spider Webs
Rooms.Description:
For some reason these huge spider webs have remained clustered on
the walls here.  They partially obstruct the passage, which leads
north-south with a short jaunt west.  The dragons are not particularly
adept at housekeeping, but fragile stuff like spider webs is usually
burned away by one of the hatchlings' practicing.

Exits.Description: The cave continues
The cave continues
A small alcove

Rooms.Name: A small alcove
Rooms.Description:
Eeeeeeeeuuuuuuuwwwww!  The cave floor of this tiny alcove in the
cavern is covered with bat droppings!  The dragons call this their
"batting range".

Exits.Description: A large cave corridor

Rooms.Name: A nursery corner
Rooms.Description:
This whole area of the great underground dragon caves is devoted to
raising the next generation of fire breathers.  The walls are marked
randomly with scorch marks.  Young dragons have little control over
their fiery breath.  It is something they must learn in dragon school.
From here the nursery continues east, and the corridor runs
north-south.

Exits.Description: Cobwebs!
Soft pastels
A playground for small dragons

Rooms.Name: Soft pastel colors
Rooms.Description:
Before they become accustomed to the bright jewel tones favored by
adult dragons, young dragons are raised in soft, calming colors of
mint, pink, powder blue, cream and sunshine.  The cavern floor is
covered with soft sand to protect baby dragon feet.  The nursery
continues east, or you may find older dragons to the west.

Exits.Description: More of the nursery
The main north south corridor of the living quarters

Rooms.Name: Between nursery and schoolroom
Rooms.Description:
Standing outside the dragon schoolroom you hear the sleep-inducing
monotone of the dragon master, dragging on about emergency measures -
how to extinguish fires you didn't mean to start.  How extremely dull!
You might peek in at the schoolroom to the east, or head towards the
baby cries to the south.

Exits.Description: You hear the dragon master's boring voice.
You hear baby dragon cries.
The soft pastels of a dragon nursery

Rooms.Name: Dragon schoolroom
Rooms.Description:
Little round dragon stools dot the floor in an orderly pattern.
Small dragons sit on many of them, little tails draping over the 
edge.  From the number of empty stools it looks like not all the 
little dragons can be talked into going to school.

Exits.Description: The nursery corridor

Rooms.Name: Nursery west
Rooms.Description:
Newly hatched dragons spend some time in this enormous room.  The
adult dragons have smoothed out the walls and covered the floor with 
a soft white sand, but that has been their only concession to the 
necessities of dragon infancy.  Adult dragons meddle very little in 
the affairs of their offspring.

Exits.Description: A hallway
The nursery continues

Rooms.Name: Nursery east
Rooms.Description:
Remnants of nursery meals - bits of bugs, wingtips from bats - lie
on the sandy nursery floor beside forgotten or discarded toys.  The room
is bathed in a warm soft glow without any obvious source.  The nursery
is very roomy, fortunately so, as some of the clutches of eggs lately
have been much larger than usual. The egg hatchery is south of here,
and the infant nursery continues to the west.

Exits.Description: Sounds of eggs breaking
The nursery continues

Rooms.Name: Hatchery
Rooms.Description:
Bits of shell from dragon eggs litter the floor.  A few large eggs
lie dormant in the center, under a stream of pure white light coming 
from a small crack in the ceiling. Listening closely, you can barely 
hear the chanting of wiccan monks pouring through the crack with the 
light.

Exits.Description: You hear childish dragon voices

Rooms.Name: Southern end of a long dragon hallway
Rooms.Description:
The hallway here stretches from the practice room just south of here
all the way to the queen's quarters far to the north.  Although the
walls have been smoothed and well lit, the floor remains hard.  Perhaps
it serves to toughen little dragon feet before they pad out into the
forest.

Exits.Description: The hallway continues
Looks like a practice range
The molting area

Rooms.Name: Practice Range
Rooms.Description:
Here, at a dead end of the hallway, in the part of the cavern at
once furthest away from queen and from hatchlings, the young dragons 
have a spot to test their skills.  The southern, western and eastern 
walls are covered with scorch marks and deep gouges into the wall.  
The trainees look like they'd love to practice with a live target!

Exits.Description: The grand hallway of dragondom begins

Rooms.Name: Molting area
Rooms.Description:
This simple room in the dragon quarters leads south to the
entranceway and east to the grand hallway.  Here, the walls are plain, 
the young dragons have tracked some sand from the nursery onto the cave 
floor.  Young dragons molting out of their first skins have used a large 
rough area on the northern wall as a large scratching post.  Small 
patches of dragon skin have been left where they were caught by the rock.

Exits.Description: The grand hallway
The entranceway

Rooms.Name: A small space with a large sign
Rooms.Description:
A relatively small cave within the underground network, you find
your voice echoes eerily off the solid rock walls.  The sound of 
trickling water comes from through the crack in the south wall, and 
there is a very large sign here presumably to catch the attention of 
adventurers entering the caves from that direction.

Exits.Description: The passageway continues north.
You hear trickling water.
The cave gets darker.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
In very large, clumsily written letters you read:

                       Dragin Homland and Stomping Ground
                                Du Not Dysterb!

Rooms.Name: Small crypt in a large catacomb
Rooms.Description:
A large polished archway leads northwards.  The archway has been
smoothed, and the walls are filled with paintings of dragons enjoying
themselves in a hundred different pleasures.  There is some lettering
over the archway identifying this area, and a small sign at eye level.

Exits.Description: The crypt
A very small cave

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The lettering reads, "Dragon Catacombs"

The sign consists of a huge arrow pointing north and the following
crude lettering:
 
                              Dragin Treshur

Rooms.Name: A dark and lonely place
Rooms.Description:
Tis written that the grave is "a dark and lonely place".  Dragons 
don't spend much time reading, however.  North of you lies a large 
memorial to the Great Undead Dragon (GUD), and to the west the 
brightly-lit Trail of the Undead begins.  This one little room is quiet 
and dark.

Exits.Description: A GUD memorial
An arched entrance
On the trail of the undead

Rooms.Name: A GUD memorial
Rooms.Description:
This enormous cavern is covered floor to ceiling in bright colors.
Murals depicting stories from the legendary Great Dragon cover every
surface.  In the center of the floor there are two huge depressions the
exact size of the Great Dragon's footprints.  Every so often one of
this dragon generation will sneak in here to see how he or she is
measuring up, and wonder what happened to the GUD treasure hoard.
There is a small sign on one wall.

Exits.Description: The catacombs entrance

ExtraDescriptions.Description: He was GUD to all us draginz

Rooms.Name: Southern end of the Trail of the Undead
Rooms.Description:
This area of the great underground caves is colorfully known as the
Trail of the Undead.  Those dragons who, dying, fail to make the great
flight wander these halls.  Here they play some of the same games and
pranks they enjoyed when alive.  The corridor leads north for a ways,
or you may head east towards the entrance to the Dragon Catacombs.

Exits.Description: The Trail of the Undead
A dark and lonely waiting place

Rooms.Name: The Trail of the Undead
Rooms.Description:
The cavern walls are covered with murals depicting great dragons and
their treasures.  The light flooding the corridor appears to make the
painted jewels glow.  There is something about this light that makes
your skin crawl.

Exits.Description: The northern end of the corridor
A brightly lit corridor of rock

Rooms.Name: Northern end of the corridor
Rooms.Description:
The cave walls have been elaborately painted in the jewel tones the
dragons love - ruby, topaz, sapphire, emerald, amethyst.  Dragons are
very fond of collecting and hoarding treasures and over a long lifetime
can build up a huge store of riches.  Nobody is entirely certain what
happens to the treasure when a dragon dies.  Some say they take it with
them.

Exits.Description: The murals continue
The murals continue

Rooms.Name: An intersection in the dragon catacombs
Rooms.Description:
To the south and west are large crypts lined with shelves.  There is
a long corridor leading north from here and this room continues east.
The room is brightly lit, and you begin to FEEL the magic saturating
the air.

There is a large sign hanging from the ceiling.

Exits.Description: A corridor leading north
The room continues east
A small room in the catacombs
A small room in the catacombs

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large arrow points north, and the sign reads:

                           Enormuss Pile of Golld and Jules!

Rooms.Name: A small crypt in the catacombs
Rooms.Description:
This is a very small crypt, lined with shelves.  The shelves are
lined with jars made from volcanic glass.  The jars are filled with the 
ashes of those dragons whose remains could be captured before they were 
blown away by the winds of fate.  Some of the jars have been opened, 
perhaps by greedy adventurers in search of treasure.

Exits.Description: The trail through the catacombs

Rooms.Name: Yet another small crypt
Rooms.Description:
You are in a small, brightly lit room, again saturated with magic
light.  The walls are painted with pictures of the great dragon
treasures amassed by famous dragons of long ago.  There is a small
trail of ashes from an urn which has spilled.

Exits.Description: Another small crypt
The corridor through the catacombs

Rooms.Name: Following the Catacomb Path
Rooms.Description:
The rock of the cavern floor is hard against your feet, but the
ground is fairly level as you follow the clearly marked path through the
dragon burial grounds.  The catacombs are fairly thickly populated with
departed dragons who have yet to learn the meaning of "eternal rest".

Exits.Description: The catacombs continue
The catacombs continue
A small crypt lies to the west

Rooms.Name: A large dark vault
Rooms.Description:
Unlike the rest of the catacombs that you have seen so far, this
vault is painted in dark, gloomy colors, the colors of night and mud and 
the dark side.  There are vaults in the wall containing glass coffins.
Some of the coffins contain dragon bodies with large wooden stakes
protruding from them.  Looking around for some understanding of what
you see, you spot a small sign.

Exits.Description: The catacomb corridor
A small crypt

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Here lie the bodies of those few dragons who were truly evil.  We have
skewered them to their coffins in hopes that they will thus not arise
against us, and we have enclosed them in glass that we may look upon
them and revile them.  And keep an eye on them just in case.

Rooms.Name: Serpentine corridor
Rooms.Description:
The catacomb path curves sharply here.  The walls as well as the
ceiling glow with a creepy magic light.  You wonder at the effect of
this magic on growing young things.  You may follow the path of
increasing light to the west or head down the corridor to the south.
There is a large sign here to help you decide.

Exits.Description: A catacomb corridor, ending in a small crypt
A brighter glow

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a large arrow pointing west, and the words:
 
               Hed West to the Lejenderry Dragin Treshur!

Rooms.Name: More catacombic twists
Rooms.Description:
The catacomb path continues to twist here, curving from north to
east.  The walls are glowing with a soft topaz light, reminding you of 
the dragons' love for that gem.  The ceiling is glowing with the 
dazzling white light of a thousand diamonds.  The glow continues to the 
north and decreases slightly to the east.

Exits.Description: Dazzling
A softer glow

Rooms.Name: Near the source
Rooms.Description:
Walls, ceiling and floor all glow with bright jewel colors.  Could
the amassed treasure of all the dragons who have passed away be the 
source of this light and color?  Could you possibly grab some of the 
fabulous fortune for yourself?  If it is as large as is rumored, they 
could easily spare you a few small jewels!  

There is another sign here.

Exits.Description: A bright glow
A softer glow

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
It points east.
 
                 Fabulus Jules!  Dragin Treshur for them with Kerage!

Rooms.Name: Near the Glowing Light
Rooms.Description:
The light and heat coming from the east is overpowering.  You feel
drawn there, compelled almost against your will as you have all along
this long journey through the caves.  You are frightened at the
outpouring of magic from the room.  It will take enormous resolve to
turn back the way you came, but that is by far the safer route.  Is
this next room truly the storehouse of dragon treasure?  or a trap set
by canny dragons?  There is a large sign here which may offer you some
advice.

Exits.Description: Dragon Crematorium
A turn in the catacombs

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Like others in the catacombs, this sign features a gigantic arrow (this
one is glowing and flashing and pointing east) and some writing:
 
                         Huge Heap uv Dragin Treshur!

Rooms.Name: The Great Dragon Crematorium
Rooms.Description:
You have stepped into the crematorium and been burned to ashes.
What did you expect to happen in a crematorium?

Rooms.Name: The cave tunnel
Rooms.Description:
An endless tunnel drops rapidly down into the cool stone walls of an
underground cave.  Although most cave passages are formed by the
actions of water over millenia, this particular passageway appears to
have been formed by a blasting heat.  You try to remember what little
you once knew about volcanoes.

Exits.Description: Fresh air
The perils of a network of underground caves.

Mobs.Name: closet monster m6700
Mobs.LongDescription: A dark closet monster hides, waiting for some dummy to open the door.
Mobs.Description:
A vague black shape, hiding in the back of the closet, glowing eyes
peeking out at you from a half-opened closet door, the closet monster
lurks.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%90 close door;%5 cackle;%59 snarl;%1 curse

Mobs.Name: under-the-bed monster m6701
Mobs.LongDescription: The under-the-bed monster has strong hands that GRAB you!!
Mobs.Description:
Annie's under-the-bed monster is the stuff of nightmares.  He has long
sharp teeth to tear your flesh and long, strong arms that whip out from
under the bed, fast as lightning, to drag you underneath and EAT YOU
UP!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%30 emote suddenly #rsnakes#W out from under the bed and makes a fast 
grab for your ankles !!!

Mobs.Name: aarakocra
Mobs.LongDescription: The aarakocra soars swiftly by high above you.
Mobs.Description:
Were you to stand next to him, you would see this bird-man is about the
height of a 12 year old human, however his wingspan is nearly 4 times
his height.  What makes this an especially dangerous bird is his
ability to swoop suddenly and rapidly down at you from the sky.  From
his powerful feet with the long, agile talons to his sharp beak, you
can see he is an adversary worthy of the finest knight.

Mobs.Name: gryphon
Mobs.LongDescription: The gryphon flies at you, claws and fangs poised for attack!
Mobs.Description:
A sleek and powerful cat, with claws as long as your fingers and
powerful jaws lined with sharp teeth.  The gryphon has a pair of small
but mighty wings giving her great mobility.  Her thick, dense fur is an
excellent protection against attack, and her fearsome appearance is
enough to scare off all but the most determined of predators.

Mobs.Name: vulture
Mobs.LongDescription: Circling above you, the vulture patiently waits to attack.
Mobs.Description:
The vulture's feathers are black as night in a coal mine.  He circles
lazily over the landscape, looking for the dead, but he is not averse
to helping the death process along.  He has a beak which hooks sharply
and he uses it to rip flesh from dying bodies.  He watches you with
evilly glowing golden eyes.

Mobs.Name: wyvern
Mobs.LongDescription: The wyvern flickers his forked tongue at you menacingly.
Mobs.Description:
A tall, tough-skinned gray-green dragon with small, leathery wings, the
wyvern is all sharp points.  His teeth are those of a carnivore who
rips bites off his prey then swallows them whole.  There is a
protective ridge of spines down his back and along his short tail.
Even his wing tips end in sharp claws.  The wyvern snarls and attacks
everything he sees.

Mobs.Name: master ranger MrRanger
Mobs.LongDescription: The Master Ranger ceaselessly roams the kingdom, fighting evil.
Mobs.Description:
The Master Ranger is noble, fearless, shiningly strong and brave.  He
is ruthless in his attempts to root out evil.  He is an elf of the
forest, and dressed to blend in with his surroundings in deep green and
chocolate suede over his tough mithril chainmail.  When he meets your
eyes you fear he will see every wicked thought within you, and you
quiver before his might.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 flex;%2 say FEAR the Mighty Ranger's wrath!!

Mobs.Name: elf forest-dweller
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf nervously watches the sky as he hurries along.
Mobs.Description:
With his quiver of arrows slung across his back and a bow in one hand,
the elf looks ready for danger.  These are perilous times that try
elves' patience!  Not only have the dragons taken up hunting elves for
fun, but there seem to be a lot of other creatures who have taken up
the same sport!  Of course, the elves, having good on their side, will
win.  But at what cost?
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 wrestle

Mobs.Name: elf woman female
Mobs.LongDescription: The elf looks worriedly back at her home.
Mobs.Description:
A dainty female elf, with long curly blond hair and an air of worry.
She has had to leave her children alone while she goes to the healer's
for some coltsfoot for her cough.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 headache

Mobs.Name: ancient elder elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The wizened elf remembers dragon plagues of old.
Mobs.Description:
The elder is old, even by elven standards.  He remembers well the days
of the last infestation of dragons, and how so many of his friends died
in that glorious battle.

Mobs.Name: Henrietta Hennapy elf herbalist
Mobs.LongDescription: Henrietta looks up at you from the pot she is stirring.
Mobs.Description:
Henrietta Hennapy is a very very very ancient elf, source of much of
the knowledge of magic of this generation of elves.  Bring her a couple
of bat's wings and a dragon claw, a bit of pixie blood and she can make
a potion that will make you nearly invulnerable - for a time, at least.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 emote smiles indulgently at you.

Mobs.Name: cat
Mobs.LongDescription: The charcoal black cat ignores your insignificant presence.
Mobs.Description:
An exceptionally large cat, her coat shines with good health.  She is
sleek and well muscled, evidence of nights spent on the prowl in the
forest.  You have seen an abundance of birds in the forest, but all
seem too large for a cat to kill.  But then, this is no ordinary cat.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 purr

Mobs.Name: apprentice Tamric
Mobs.LongDescription: Tamric rushes to do as Henrietta asks.
Mobs.Description:
Tamric studied plants for many years with the Wiccan monks in the
village below, but he became disturbed by the way they were beginning
to "improve" on nature.  He begged Henrietta to allow him to study with
her.  Tamric is a wiry elf of medium height.  His eyes are hazel,
unusual for an elf, and his hair a tawny gold.

Mobs.Name: dragon purple
Mobs.LongDescription: The gigantic purple dragon settles comfortably on the flimsy branch.
Mobs.Description:
The gigantic dragon is a lovely shade of purple - a deep red shade
almost fuchsia.  His wings are huge but look very fragile - a gauzy web
of prism-like colors.  There is a muted pattern of stars covering his
huge body, discernible only by their faint glow.  Around his neck, the
dragon wears a large heart-shaped locket.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 bounce

Mobs.Name: dragon topaz
Mobs.LongDescription: The topaz dragon casually knocks over a small tree with his tail.
Mobs.Description:
The glowing yellow topaz dragon is beautiful.  But clumsy.  He is a
bit awkwardly proportioned for a dragon with an enormous tail and
relatively small body.  His softly glowing yellow topaz skin contrasts
brightly  with the sharp purple ridges rippling down his back and
across his tail.  He has painted his claws a bright cherry red.

Mobs.Name: dragon aquamarine
Mobs.LongDescription: A small aquamarine dragon darts at you, claws flying at your face.
Mobs.Description:
This dragon is small, as dragons go, but very fierce.  She is a pale
sea green with deep purple eyes and long dark eyelashes.  She has
strong, leathery wings and is very agile when airborne.  She is, of
course, a fire breather, but her long, sharp teeth and talons make this
ability almost unnecessary.

Mobs.Name: dragon ice
Mobs.LongDescription: The ice dragon chills you with her stare.
Mobs.Description:
Made of cold clear ice from an enchanted forest lake, the ice dragon
has a heart as cold as her long, smooth body.  Her eyes are a clear ice
blue, and she moves with agility for one of her size.  She stares at
you as if to say, "Fear me, mortal."
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote freezes you with her stare.

Mobs.Name: gold dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The shining gold dragon dazzles your eyes.
Mobs.Description:
A powerful dragon made of  gold and decorated with a king's ransom in
precious gems.  The dragon moves smoothly on air and on land, and his
graceful strength makes him a formidable adversary.  Like the other
dragons infesting Tynstri, he has a fearsome first attack with fire.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 boast;%2 hum

Mobs.Name: firedragon dragon fire
Mobs.LongDescription: The bright red and orange dragon glows with the fire of his birth.
Mobs.Description:
The firedragon glows with the heat of the fire whence he emerged.
Great tongues of fire leap from his open maw, and small fires start
with his every touch.  He moves among the trees, leaving death and
destruction in his wake.

Mobs.Name: white dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: What you thought was a cloud turns out to be a large white dragon.
Mobs.Description:
This enormous dragon is a pure white in color and at first you want to
believe that it is a cloud come to life.  His outlines are obscured by
the white smoke billowing from his flared nostrils, and a quick,
darting tongue of flame burns the leaves off nearby trees.  The
dragon's enormous tail is covered with long, dense white fur that
belies the whiplike strength with which the dragon wields it.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 bungy;%1 charge

Mobs.Name: honor guard Honora
Mobs.LongDescription: Honora watches you suspiciously, honor-bound to protect the throne.
Mobs.Description:
Her long straight blond hair braided and secured to her head, Honora is
proud of her position as part of the elf king's honor guard.  She looks
at you from her serious blue eyes, watching you to be sure you don't
try to steal or defile anything belonging to her king.

Mobs.Name: guard honor petra
Mobs.LongDescription: Petra stands immobile, staring stonily ahead of her.
Mobs.Description:
Petra is an exceptionally strong elf, dressed in shining white armor.
Her normal job is simply to oversee the small groups of young elves who
come in awe to see the home of their king, but if the visitors are
intent on theft or harm she is quite capable of defending the throne.

Mobs.Name: Purity honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Purity paces about the king's quarters, watching you suspiciously.
Mobs.Description:
Purity has waist length honey golden blond hair with deep green eyes.
Her ears are a trifle too round on top to be perfect.  She has a small,
pointed chin and a wide smile with deep dimples on either side.  She is
often reprimanded by the stricter members of her troop for humming to
herself, but she is usually too cheerful to mind.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 say Wonder when he'll be back.

Mobs.Name: Chastity honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Chastity idly polishes gold fixings and the throne.
Mobs.Description:
Chastity has the face of an angel, with delicate, pale features, a
sweet smile and nicely pointed ears.  Her fair, transparent skin
readily reveals her slightest blush, and she is easily embarrassed.
Her hair is an ice blond, so pale that in some light it looks white.
In spite of her apparent fragility she is quite strong, and an awesome
opponent.

Mobs.Name: Patience honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Patience would rather be out fighting dragons than waiting idly.
Mobs.Description:
Patience would actually rather be doing anything than standing here
shepherding little children through sightseeing tours.  She is very
active and seems to be in constant motion.  Her hands are ever moving,
readjusting her uniform, straightening the many objets d'art which
clutter the throne room.

Mobs.Name: Faith honor guard
Mobs.LongDescription: Faith stands quietly by the throne, prepared for intruders.
Mobs.Description:
Aptly named, Faith will stand faithfully at her post for a decade, if
need be.  The only non-elf in the honor guard, Faith is half-elven and
half-gnome, the result of what her mother thinks of as an "unfortunate
incident" that happened on an adventure far away.  She is tiny for an
elf, with bright red hair that she keeps hidden beneath the white
helmet of her uniform.  Her green eyes look watchfully at you.

Mobs.Name: ruby dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The blood red ruby dragon glows with a deep inner fire.
Mobs.Description:
The same deep red as the heart of a ruby, this dragon glows with an
inner fire.  Constantly flying the Tynstrian forests, gloatingly free of
the dark cave of her birth, the dragon heartlessly turns elven homes to
burnt coals.  She blows a long tongue of flame, filled with pleasure at
the color and the warmth.  About her neck she wears a silver id chain.

Mobs.Name: rats rat
Mobs.LongDescription: The tower rats squeak "eep!" as they skitter from under your feet.
Mobs.Description:
Red eyes glowing in the dark, the small tower rat cowers at your
approach, nose twitching as he catches your scent.  The rat has a long
pinkish tail devoid of the black fur that covers the  rest of his body.
His yellowing rodent teeth are always sharp.

Mobs.Name: emerald dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The deep green emerald dragon seems to blend in with the forest.
Mobs.Description:
At first you think the sunlight on the leaves has made an unusually
interesting pattern.  Then you realize that what is facing you is a
dragon made of an enormous, glowing gemstone.  At 40' tall (over 6m) he
towers over you, and glares greenly down at you as if you were a small
snack.

Mobs.Name: crystal dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The crystal dragon softly scorches you with a blast of steam.
Mobs.Description:
A very young dragon, as dragons go, the crystal dragon is still trying
out her wings (and her fire).  Sometimes when she means to burn a
village, she only succeeds in helping light a fire in a fireplace.
Other times she sneezes and starts a forest fire.  Very self-conscious
(for a dragon), you will frequently see her polishing her crystalline
scales.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%05 emote carefully polishes her scales.; %5 fashion; %2 hum

Mobs.Name: amethyst dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The amethyst dragon unfurls her pale violet wings, stretching.
Mobs.Description:
The amethyst dragon glows with the pale violet colors of early dawn.
About 25' (8m) tall from the ends of her deep purple claws to the top
of the rigid ruffle of points that extends from her small head, the
amethyst dragon is small as dragons go.  Her eyes glow a dark crimson
from their deeply placed sockets.  Her wings stretch 50' from pointed
wing tip to pointed wing tip.

Mobs.Name: shadow dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The shadow dragon is a vague threatening shape against the sky.
Mobs.Description:
The shadow dragon is not often seen, but his awesome presence is often
felt as clearly as one feels the imminence of rainfall.  He is the most
massive of dragons.  His color is the dark gray of thunderclouds, and
his breath is like lightning.  A king of dragons, he is usually content
to wait for excitement to find him.  He has little taste for hunting.

Mobs.Name: banshee
Mobs.LongDescription: Your mind screams with pain as the banshee wails.
Mobs.Description:
Undead feminine spirit or strange, live woman?  When she begins to
scream you realize in horror it is a banshee.  She is tall and slender
with an athletic grace.  Her hair is a blue so dark it appears black,
making her pallid face appear ghostly.  Her playful smile reveals
sharply pointed teeth, and as she reaches out a thin pale hand to you,
you recoil from the talons at the ends of each finger.

Mobs.Name: dwarf woodcutter
Mobs.LongDescription: The dwarven woodcutter swings his axe with great strength and agility.
Mobs.Description:
With all of the power of the dreaded ogre, but none of the height or
the smell, this particular dwarf owes his overdeveloped muscles to his
preoccupation with cutting down the forest of Tynstri. Cutting down
forests is something he has done all his life.  Lately, however, he's
been disturbed to notice the trees have started to bleed when cut.

Mobs.Name: adventurer elf
Mobs.LongDescription: The tiny elf strides along the path to adventure.
Mobs.Description:
He is a fairly tiny elf, but full of energy and determination.  He grew
up during the famine which followed the last great dragon infestation,
when so many elves died of starvation.  He has heard rumors that the
dragons are once again breeding, and has set out upon an adventure to
discover the truth.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%2 emote sings as he walks along, "#yMacho, macho elf!  I wanna be a 
macho elf! #W"

Mobs.Name: dancing wood elf
Mobs.LongDescription: Wildly dancing, the wood elf barely notices your presence.
Mobs.Description:
A jaunty little elf with skin the color of bright autumn maple leaves
and hair a golden honey color, the elf has lost himself in his joyous
dance.  It would be heartless of you to disturb him.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%3 dance; %3 tango elf

Mobs.Name: wood elf drinking
Mobs.LongDescription: The wood elf gives you a sly, slow, slightly tipsy wink.
Mobs.Description:
Wood elves have a reputation for being carefree and merry making.  This
elf is doing his best to earn that reputation.  He has filled his bota
with a rich red wine purloined from the wine cellar in Tynstri, and he
has been drinking freely from it for several hours now.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 stare; %2 snap;%5 hiccup;%1 wink

Mobs.Name: wood elf listener
Mobs.LongDescription: The young wood elf listens raptly to the tales of long ago.
Mobs.Description:
Dressed in ragged but colorful clothing, the young elf lives for now
and for pleasure.  She is merry by nature, and devoted to pleasure.
She is particularly enchanted by stories of old, of brave knights and
wicked dragons, beautiful princesses and noble heroes.

Mobs.Name: singing elf wood
Mobs.LongDescription: The pretty wood elf's merry voice sings of good times and good friends.
Mobs.Description:
The singer has cut short her pale blond hair and dyed it many colors
with the carefully gathered flowers and barks of her forest elf kin.
Using pine resins, she has formed it into interesting sworls and spikes
about her head.  She sings loud and happy songs and can often be found
trailing through the forest with a small following of admirers.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%3 airguitar

Mobs.Name: storyteller wood elf
Mobs.LongDescription: A long bearded elf tells of fierce battles with mighty dragons.
Mobs.Description:
The old wood elf has a long thin beard that trails to his knees.  He
tells a story to an enchanted audience.  The story recounts the days of
the last dragon invasion, when an evil mage brought dragon eggs to the
caverns beneath the lake in the Tynstri forest.  The mage believed he
would be able to control dragons raised from hatchlings and thus have
the enormous power of dragons at his command.

Mobs.Name: gnome walker
Mobs.LongDescription: The gnome scientist searches for the fabled Cave of the Dragons.
Mobs.Description:
Only 4' tall (about 1m.), the gnome is not quite as stout as those of
his race tend to be.  He is strong from his treks through the woods,
looking for dragon droppings.  This particular scientist is on the
trail of the dragon outlet.  He knows that dragons breed and raise
their young deep below the surface of the earth.  He hopes to find the
outlet to their cave and block it, ending the current scourge of
dragons.

Mobs.Name: goblin gobble-un
Mobs.LongDescription: The gobble-un eyes you thinking, "Roasted or raw?"  He says, "Wanna PK?"
Mobs.Description:
Short, squat, bald and green, this branch of the goblin family went
their own way some hundreds of years ago. Sometimes they shine up their
pointy ears with walnut oil and pretend (to each other) to be elves.
This particular gobble-un is HUNGRY for ADVENTURERS!  (like you)  He
waits impatiently, eager for someone to foolishly accept his challenge
and become his dinner.  Just remember ...The gobble-un 'll get you, ef
you don't watch out!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 drool;%1 grimace;%1 curse

Mobs.Name: lynx
Mobs.LongDescription: The graceful lynx crouches in a tree, ready to pounce.
Mobs.Description:
A beautiful tawny yellow coat covers this graceful cat from twitching
nose and whiskers to the end of her very short tail.  She's usually to
be found napping high in a tree during the daytime, safe from the
wolves roaming the forest.  At night she is the consummate hunter,
pulling down small deer and even dwarves.

Mobs.Name: sasquatch woman female
Mobs.LongDescription: The large furry female looks warily at you before moving quietly away.
Mobs.Description:
This sasquatch woman is smaller than her mate, who is foraging nearby
in the forest.  She is about 2 metres (6'8") tall, and her dense black
fur provides protection from the thorns and twigs of her environment.
A peaceful creature, she means you no harm.

Mobs.Name: sasquatch man male
Mobs.LongDescription: The sasquatch man hums quietly to himself as he moves about the forest.
Mobs.Description:
Tall enough to be of the giant race, the sasquatch is nevertheless a
separate species.  He has a large, very muscular body covered with a
thin soft brown fur, which has begun to silver around his head and down
his back.  He moves quietly about the forest.

Mobs.Name: wood sprite
Mobs.LongDescription: The tiny wood sprite smothers a giggle so he can surprise you.
Mobs.Description:
Eyes sparkling with mischief, the tiny wood sprite loves to tease.  He
hides, invisible to normal folk, waiting for the unwary.  This
particular wood sprite is dressed all in green so as to be all but
invisible even to mages.

Mobs.Name: alpha wolf female werewolf
Mobs.LongDescription: Powerful and cunning, the she wolf bares her teeth to warn you off.
Mobs.Description:
The female alpha wolf is sleek, strong and fast.  Moving, she is a gray
blur against the landscape. Still, her deep gray fur glows with health
and with the deep magic that makes her a shape shifter.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: alpha wolf male werewolf
Mobs.LongDescription: Snarling low in his throat, the alpha male werewolf prepares to leap.
Mobs.Description:
Ice blue eyes stare back at you unblinkingly from a silver gray face.
You sense his pride in his leadership of the pack, and the strength of
body and of mind that has made him the leader.  His thick silver-gray
fur provides protection against both cold and sharp-toothed predators.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: curious werewolf wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The sleek black wolf sniffs curiously at the air, intrigued.
Mobs.Description:
This werewolf's thick fur is a deep, rich black, matching her dark
eyes.  On moonless nights she moves quietly through the forest, unseen
and unheard by normal souls.  Her keen senses pick up on slight
variations in color, texture, noise and scent, and this world has an
endless fascination for her.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote sniffs curiously at you.;%1 nose wolf;%1nose werewolf;
%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: ferocious werewolf wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The ferocious werewolf crouches low, preparing to SPRING at you.
Mobs.Description:
The werewolf looks back at you hungrily, ready to rip out your throat
for the pleasure of the kill.  His long front canines are quite sharp
and capable of doing a great deal of damage to your tender skin.  Fight
or flee?  He is too swift for you to outrun, but those same muscles
will make him an awesome opponent.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf

Mobs.Name: wolf cub werewolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The werewolf cub snarls bravely at you, baring his mighty fangs.
Mobs.Description:
Although younger and less powerful than the adults of his pack, the
werewolf cub makes up for this with sheer outrageous courage.  He will
attack any prey with the rest of his pack, no matter how much larger or
stronger it is.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: hunter wolf
Mobs.LongDescription: The lean hungry wolf swifly but silently stalks her prey.
Mobs.Description:
Injured in a fight with one of the tawny-coated lynxes that inhabit
this forest, the wolf was left behind by her pack when they moved on to
a less crowded area of the forest.  She has been hunting on her own
ever since, not always successfully.  Her coat is shaggy and dull, and
there is a mean, hungry look in her eyes.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 emote snarls viciously at you, baring long sharp teeth.;%2 howl

Mobs.Name: lame wolf hobbling
Mobs.LongDescription: The three-legged werewolf snarls viciously at you.
Mobs.Description:
One of the dangers of living near the dragon caves is the inevitability
of occasional encounters with dragonkind.  While the large, mature
dragons live mostly higher up in the trees and the young dragons live
deep in the caves, during the migrations of the adolescent dragons some
occasionally try their new skills out on the forest floor.  This poor
werewolf was one of the casualties of a mis-directed blast of fire.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 howl;%1 nose wolf;%1 lick wolf;%1nose werewolf;%1 lick werewolf

Mobs.Name: Baby Blue dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The big baby blue dragon plays quietly with her toys.
Mobs.Description:
Baby Blue is a lovely soft pastel shade of blue, with deeper blue wings
ending in indigo wingtips.  Although still an infant, it's clear that
she will be a very large dragon when full grown.  She lacks the
go-for-the-throat attitude of her hatch mates, however, and may never
take advantage of her size.

Mobs.Name: Bubba dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Bubba can't fly yet, but he can roll over you like a mighty rockfall.
Mobs.Description:
One enormous dragon!  Not anywhere near his full growth yet, Bubba
towers over all the other hatchlings from his clutch.  His dragon
master tells him if he keeps eating the elf cook's cream puffs at the
rate he's going he won't be able to fit out the exit tunnel of the
cave.  Bubba's not sure that's such a big deal.  He's not sure he will
ever be able to fly.  And there is something to be said for a life
spent eating cream puffs!

Mobs.Name: cave bat
Mobs.LongDescription: Is this hairy scary cave bat a vampire?  Hard to tell!
Mobs.Description:
Hanging upside down from the ceiling of this small cave is an enormous
bat.  The bat is so big its head is hanging down near your groin.  It
has large leathery wings covered in a light fur, and you notice a
slight drool coming from it's mouth.  You wonder what a bat this size
would eat.  You hope it isn't you.

Mobs.Name: Chucky mannequin doll
Mobs.LongDescription: The evil doll grins at you, saying, "I'm b-a-a-a-c-k!"
Mobs.Description:
An evil drow mage once sent a truckload of these dolls to infest a
small elven orphanage.  On one of his rare excursions outside the cave,
Sneaker stole the dolls and brought them back to the dragon nursery.
The Chucky dolls are wooden mannequins about the height of a small
wolf.  They are very vicious, and very brutal when they don't get their
own way.  Unfortunately for them, the dragons use the really nasty ones
as target practice for their fireballs.  Nothing warms a dragon's heart
like the sight of a Chucky doll going up in flames.

Mobs.Name: dragon ghost ghostly
Mobs.LongDescription: A faintly discernible image shimmers in the air beside you.
Mobs.Description:
A chill blows over you, despite your enclosed surroundings.  You can
feel it even in your bones.  The great dragon, last of his clan, swore
as he died to haunt those who would destroy his kind.  He does indeed
inspire a mind-numbing fear.

Mobs.Name: dragon mummy
Mobs.LongDescription: The dragon mummy wanders endlessly through dark and lonely caves.
Mobs.Description:
Rather than being cremated, as is the custom for dragons who have
passed on to the greater glory, this poor dragon's relatives wanted to
keep his beautiful dragon body around for posterity.  They had it
mummified and embalmed by the funeral home owned by Howard.  The staff
boasted great experience, having embalmed most of those now buried
under the Midgaard Chapel.  Unfortunately, the staff was corrupt, inept
and downright evil.  The mummy is doomed to walk the caves of its
birthplace until someone puts it (at least temporarily) out of its
misery.

Mobs.Name: skeleton dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The dragon skeleton creaks eerily as it wanders the caves.
Mobs.Description:
What is it searching for in its endless wandering through the caves of
its homeland?  Nobody seems to know, but the young dragons have learned
to ignore it.  Except when it tries to climb in bed with them at night,
of course.  *shiver*

Mobs.Name: zombie dragon
Mobs.LongDescription:
The zombie dragon shuffles along, filling the cave with a ghostly
smoke.
Mobs.Description:
Zed the Zombie.  Not too frightening, is he?  Just because he is
MASSIVELY larger than you, has a mouthful of glistening white teeth and
could crush you with one swipe of his tail is no reason to panic!  (Or
is it? :)

Mobs.Name: undead dragon GUD
Mobs.LongDescription: The GUD charges at you with a quiet roar of displeasure!
Mobs.Description:
The Great Undead Dragon (known in the dragon nursery as the GUD) is
doomed to walk the trail of the undead through the Great Dragon Crypt
for all eternity, or at least as long as the cave stands.  Death has
not improved his particularly nasty disposition, and he is likely to
attack any and all who venture near him.

Mobs.Name: ghost lost newbie
Mobs.LongDescription: "Have you seen my corpse?" asks the ghost of the lost newbie.
Mobs.Description:
Wandering lost and bewildered, this poor adventurer never had a chance.
He stumbled into a mature dragon when he was yet an infant in
experience and alas, never found his corpse.  He is doomed to roam
forevermore in these caves beneath the monastery.

Mobs.Name: phantom
Mobs.LongDescription: The Phantom of the Cavern's music weaves spells of great evil.
Mobs.Description:
His dragon face mostly covered by a white plaster mask, the evil
Phantom of the Cavern was once a lowly bard who wandered into these
caves in search of the perfect set of stalactites with which to create
a great cave organ.  Burned into insanity as a result of a brush with
the crematorium, he has haunted these dark caves ever since.  He
enchants with his music, but 'tis an evil enchantment.

Mobs.Name: skeleton dragon hero
Mobs.LongDescription: The massive skeleton of an undead dragon hero moves slowly towards you.
Mobs.Description:
The greatest of all the old time dragon heroes, this dragon died over a
thousand years ago.  Does any body this massive ever completely die?
Evidently this one has not, for it has been wandering the dragon caves
for a millenium.

Mobs.Name: teleporting mage ghost
Mobs.LongDescription: The ghostly mage screams, "CAST 'TELEPORT' ME!!!"
Mobs.Description:
Alas, this would-be great wizard teleported herself right into a nest
of playful dragons.  They thought she would make a great toy and were
very disappointed when she didn't last for very long.  She has her
revenge, however.  She will be haunting these caves as long as they are
here.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%1 moan

Mobs.Name: Daffodil daffy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Daffy flaps her infant wings as hard as she can, creating a sandstorm.
Mobs.Description:
Born a soft creamy yellow, Daffodil's color has deepened to the yellow
of spring daffodils.  Nicknamed Daffy for the silly things she does,
Daffy is still a favorite in the nursery.  Except, of course, when she
whips up a strong wind with her wings!

Mobs.Name: dragon fourth forth 4th consort
Mobs.LongDescription: "Wanna PK?", yawns the dragon.
Mobs.Description:
A virtual dragon database of information about the latest in armor and
