dragon enemies, this old guy knows it all.  Let him tell you about his
masterful defeat of the master ranger, or the time he made the elf king
flee.  For all his knowledge and for all his toys, the old coot has a
strong aura of boredom surrounding him.

Mobs.Name: dragon consort
Mobs.LongDescription: The queen's consort idly shoots darts into a picture of the elf king.
Mobs.Description:
The post sounded ideal, of course.  All this powerful knightly dragon
had to do was kick back and look studly. His official duty is to
protect the queen and provide adult supervision to the hatchlings, but
in reality he spends his days gossiping with the other consorts while
the hatchlings play wild games.

Mobs.Name: dragon master dm MrTeacher
Mobs.LongDescription: #RThe Dragon Master tells you, "Interruptions are not allowed!"#N
Mobs.Description:
The Dragon Master is attempting to teach the young dragons the
rudimentary skills of dragonhood, that is, breathing fire, devastating
villages, eating elves, and so forth.  He does not appreciate
interruptions to his classes.  He is a short-tempered dragon who would
rather be flying about the forest with his brethren.

Mobs.Name: dragon queen smd sexy mud
Mobs.LongDescription:
The sexy mud dragon looks you over from under very thick (and very
fake) lashes, wondering whether you are worth the bother of killing.
Mobs.Description:
From the tip of her very beautiful (to a dragon) long tail to the end
of her toothy smile, the DraGoN QuEeN is the image of female dragon
beauty.  You may suspect that the tail has been artificially enhanced,
that the teeth have been whitened and sharpened by one of the dragon
mages, but the effect is nevertheless overpowering.  Male dragons are
instantly hit with an uncontrollable desire to take her places and give
her expensive toys.  One gift clearly was the lovely id bracelet she
wears on one dainty dragon ankle.

Mobs.Name: studly dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The very studly dragon struts around the cave, flexing his muscles.
Mobs.Description:
The young dragon is very pleased with himself and his appearance.
Certain that he has the shiniest and newest of dragon armor, that his
muscles are the bulgiest, his teeth the pointiest, his spells the
scariest and his breath the nastiest, his arrogance is matchless.  He
is certain that of all the Queen's consorts, he is her secret heart's
desire.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%5 flex;%2 emote admires himself in the mirror.;%3 emote flexes his  
mighty biceps, showing off his sexy mud dragon tattoo.

Mobs.Name: elf slave cook chef
Mobs.LongDescription: Slaving away over a hot stove, the elven chef curses fate.
Mobs.Description:
Chosen more by accident than for her extraordinary ability to make
delicious meals from unusual ingredients, the elven chef is a true
artist in the kitchen.  Tall and strong, she bullies the weaker dragons
into fetching the ingredients that she needs from the surface world.
Unfortunately for her, she is guarded by some of the stronger dragons.
The DraGoN QueEn gets quite grumpy when she doesn't eat regularly.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 wetfish;%2 taunt dragon;%2 wrestle;%2 headache

Mobs.Name: Froggy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Froggy hops over to you, long dragon tongue shooting out to sample you.
Mobs.Description:
Froggy was born a deep green frog color!  When Moonshine is mad at her,
she calls her Toad.  The dragons are rarely mad at Froggy, though.  She
hops happily around the caves going "Ribbit! Ribbit!" and pretending to
be a frog.  You will notice the absence of flies in the cave ...
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 hop

Mobs.Name: gentle dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The tall dragon towers over you before gently flame-broiling you.
Mobs.Description:
In truth, a dragon can be quite gentle when he is as powerful as this
one.  Due to his size he must unfortunately eat quite often, but he
tries very hard not to scare his dinner too badly.  It's bad for the
digestion, of course, to eat something that was frightened to death.

Mobs.Name: grumbly dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Grumbly glares, her eyebrowns drawn together in a perpetual frown.
Mobs.Description:
"You'll never lure a nice meal to you if you are always in a bad mood,
Grumbly,", the DraGoN QueEn admonishes Grumbly.  But it is in her
nature to be unhappy with the world as it is, and to share her
displeasure with her fellow dragons.  As a result, they tend to avoid
her and she has that much more to grumble about.
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 emote mutters softly under her breath about idiot adventurers.;%2
emote grumbles unintelligibly to herself.;%1 emote grumbles, "Sunshine 
is entirely too sunny, and Moonshine is entirely too full of himself."

Mobs.Name: HotShot dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: HotShot shoots a small but very hot tongue of flame towards you!
Mobs.Description:
Some dragons are just born talented.  HotShot made the old Dragon Queen
cry with joy when she hatched.  HotShot blasted her way out of her
shell with tiny shots of white-hot flame.  Her flame red color
contrasts sharply with the soft pastels of her siblings and cousins
here in the nursery.  The dragons have great hopes for her future even
though she is as yet quite small.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 gloat;%5 boast

Mobs.Name: jackrabbit
Mobs.LongDescription: The jackrabbit bounds rapidly away from you on long strong rabbit legs.
Mobs.Description:
Measured from the tips of his very long upstanding ears to the tips of
his very long feet, the jackrabbit would be near the height of that
gnome who's been pacing through the woods.  But it is unlikely the
jackrabbit will allow you close enough to measure him!
Mobs.ActionScript: %%2 hop;%2 jump;%3 emote twitches his nose and whiskers.

Mobs.Name: Dood dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Dood flexes his mighty tail and blows some mighty fire.
Mobs.Description:
Dood dreams of days when he will fly with his mighty wings high above
Tynstri, terrorizing the villagers, the monks and even the fish in the
lake.  He will be the Ultimate dragon and elves will quake at the sound
of his name!
Mobs.ActionScript:
%%1 say excellent!;%1 say Yo! doods and doodettes!;%1 say like totally, 
man!; %1 say I love you man!; %1 embrace dragon; %1 say as if!; %1 say 
Duh! my bad!; %2 say so that's how you get your jollies! picking on 
poor little baby dragons!

Mobs.Name: KaBoom! dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: "KaBoom!  KaBoom!", says the little dragon, as he detonates his toy.
Mobs.Description:
KaBoom! got his nickname when some dwarven miners mistakenly thought
that this particular cavern might make a good place to explore.  One of
the adult dragons detonated them, and then there were no more miners.
KaBoom! was very excited about the explosions and has been running
around practicing that spell ever since.  Fortunately for you, he is
still a little young to have perfected it.

Mobs.Name: Mole dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Soft and quiet, Mole sneaks up behind you and steals your weapons.
Mobs.Description:
Stealth isn't normal for dragons.  Not at all.  Not a bit!  But with
Mole it's second nature.  He is dark for a dragon - a deep brown gray
that blends with unpainted cavern walls.  He moves quietly, learning to
steal what other dragons take by force.

Mobs.Name: Moonshine dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A dragon the color of moonshine eyes you with a calculating sparkle.
Mobs.Description:
Moonshine's adventures easily eclipse those of his twin sister,
Sunshine.  He is by far the more courageous of the pair and is liable
to be found anywhere in the great underground series of caves, even
(when he escapes from the Dragon Master) along the great Trail of the
Undead  Dragons.

Mobs.Name: Oopsi dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Oopsi casually stumbles over nothing and comes crashing into you! OUCH!
Mobs.Description:
To say she is a little clumsy would be an understatement.  Oopsi's
problem isn't just that her feet are way too large for the rest of her
body, it's the whole coordination thing.  Still, she is a dragon and
should find someone like, say, you, easy enough to manage.

Mobs.Name: PinKy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Midget dragon PinKy looks anxiously for a place to hide.
Mobs.Description:
A tiny pink dragon, PinKy has always been a little self-concious
because of her size.  The older dragons tell her that magic does not
require great strength, but she is still frightened of much of her
world.  The elders despair of her ever being ready to leave the
cavenest.

Mobs.Name: Splat! dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Splat! you go as Splat! hops up and down on top of you.
Mobs.Description:
Splat! is a VERY hefty dragon who has yet to learn proper rules of
dragon decorum.  Her favorite attack is to jump wildly up and down on
top of her victim.  Due to her size and lack of serious prey in the
dragon caves, this is actually quite effective!

Mobs.Name: Puff dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Puff! casually blows a cloud of smoke your way.
Mobs.Description:
Puff! has got this smoke blowing thing down very well!  He can blow
rings and squares and small clouds at will.  The other young dragons,
who are in truth a bit jealous, say it's because he gets all the
choicest bits of adventurer to eat.

Mobs.Name: ScreaMEr dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: ScreaMEr lets out a string of dragon obscenities.
Mobs.Description:
A bit spoiled, ScreaMEr tends to throw wild tantrums when she doesn't
get her own way.  Sometimes she just stomps off screaming, "I'll never
play with you again.  I HATE you!" and sometimes she attacks, claws
flying.

Mobs.Name: SmoKy dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: SmoKy sees you and quickly disappears behind a cloud of smoke.
Mobs.Description:
This beautifully pale gray dragon finds it easy to hide in a cloud of
smoke, and at her age she is pretty good at creating the smoke.  SmoKy
is a bit shy, but she is looking forward to heading out of the caves
and into the forest soon.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%10 cast 'invisibility' SmoKy;%5 smoke;%5 pose;%5 crack;%10 vis

Mobs.Name: Sneaker dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Sneaker sits down to enjoy the cookies he "found" in Puff's hidey-hole.
Mobs.Description:
Sneaker is, unfortunately, a little sneak.  A very clever little sneak,
at that!  He is quite good at discovering where his cousins have hidden
their treasures, then "borrowing" the treasures.  Dragons being not
known for their stealth (they are simply much too LARGE to move all
that quietly), Sneaker's father has had some serious questions for the
DraGoN QueEn about Sneaker's possible parentage.

Mobs.Name: Sunshine dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A bright yellow dragon glows at you, making you feel warm all over.
Mobs.Description:
Sunshine is a sunny bright yellow dragon named not for her color or
shine but for her disposition.  She and her twin, Moonshine, are the
newest arrivals at the dragon breeding grounds in the great cavern
under the monastery.

Mobs.Name: Swipe dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Swipe stumbles by you and suddenly you are missing your backpack!
Mobs.Description:
Swipe is in training to be the master thief.  Dragons do not usually
have the dexterity needed to excel at this profession, but Swipe has
developed the nimble fingers of an elf and a clever mind to use them.

Mobs.Name: tarantula spider
Mobs.LongDescription: With eight long furry legs, the tarantula skitters rapidly toward you.
Mobs.Description:
Gold and brown are the colors of this rather beautiful spider.
Beautiful but deadly, that is.  The body at the center of the eight
long hairy legs is about the width of a human male's hand.  The legs
are each about twice that size.  The tarantula is able to move rapidly
and is not likely to attack you except in defense.

Mobs.Name: Tweaker dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Tweaker floats towards you, eyes twirling independently of each other.
Mobs.Description:
Tweaker's soft minty green has an occasional yellowish cast due to some
of the strange magical concoctions he quaffs.  This clutch of dragons
was so numerous that some of the quieter hatchlings seem to fade into
the cave walls, as if rendered invisible by their lack of importance.
Tweaker's answer to this has been to lose himself in magic.  He does
lose the feeling of invisibility with this indulgence.

Mobs.Name: violet dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The soft pale purple dragon smells of violets and springtime.
Mobs.Description:
Clearly a child of the ferocious great purple dragon who terrorizes the
skies of this elven homeland, Violet has inherited his great heart as
well as his lovely color.  The dragon master has had a difficult time
with her, however, as she would much rather be picking (and munching)
flowers than learning to burn.

Mobs.Name: Wa-Z dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Wa-Z is weakening the cavern walls with her wild wailing.
Mobs.Description:
Not a quiet infant, Wa-Z lets the world know when she is not happy.
She is not happy at the moment, and the strength of her cries is
actually weakening the magic that keeps the cavern lit.  The cries
resonate so loudly that the cavern rock is developping large cracks.

Mobs.Name: Whodeeny dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Whodeeny trips about the cave looking for rabbits to pull from his hat.
Mobs.Description:
Unfortunately for Whodeeny (the Mystical Mage to be!), all the rabbits
which might be available to live in his hat have been made into rabbit
stew by the elf cooks.  He had a stuffed rabbit when he was a little
younger, but HotShot burnt it to a crisp a year ago.  It was a vile act
of revenge.  Whodeeny hadn't really meant to make HotShot's tail turn
pink.  It just happened.

Mobs.Name: Whoosh! dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: With one mighty swoop of her wings, Whoosh! knocks you off your feet.
Mobs.Description:
"Wings as Weapons" was this studious dragons favorite reading in dragon
school.  She stole the dragon master's sole copy of the manual and
studied it every night, sneaking over to the catacombs to practice
flying.  The zombies weren't too happy at being knocked over all the
time, but Whoosh! thought it was great fun.

Mobs.Name: Wuuda dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Wuuda looks at you curiously, wondering if she is allowed to eat you.
Mobs.Description:
Wuuda is a powerful and rapidly growing young gray dragon.  She has
specialized in martial arts and is proud of the rapidly hardening
muscles in her legs and wings.  She will soon be leaving the cave to
terrorize the forest above.

Mobs.Name: fighter dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: "And I'll huff and I'll puff and I'll ...", boasts the young dragon.
Mobs.Description:
A dragon in training is an awesome sight.  It takes a lot of practice
to get the right amount of heat into your breath and to get the flame
just the right length to do the most damage.  Then there are the "how
to take care of your claws" practices and flying practice and "Wing
Care" and spells.  For most young dragons it gets to be, well, a DRAG!
but this little guy takes it quite seriously and works hard at being
the best.

Mobs.Name: ghost adventurer greedy
Mobs.LongDescription: The greedy adventurer's ghost searches forevermore for the treasure.
Mobs.Description:
An adventurer who went one step too far in her search for treasure.
'nuff said.

Mobs.Name: Jasper dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: The crystalline dragon glares fiercely at you, protecting his family.
Mobs.Description:
Jasper has declared this area to be HIS, mainly because his dear 
Chaora has chosen to nest here.  There are many large eggs here ...
eggs a bit larger than you are.  Although few will hatch, all are 
precious to Jasper.

Mobs.Name: Chaora dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: A beautiful violet dragon dressed in black lace waits for something.
Mobs.Description:
Chaora was named after the beautiful mineral Chaorite.  A beautiful
violet color, she is related to both the great purple dragon and 
to Pinky.  Unhappy with life in the dragon caves, she has chosen to
hatch her clutch right here in the trees.
Mobs.ActionScript: %%05 emote carefully polishes her scales.; %5 fashion; %2 hum

Mobs.Name: Malachi dragon
Mobs.LongDescription: Malachi seems to be in constant motion, a swirl of green color.
Mobs.Description:
Malachi has deep green, rough crocodile skin, with sworls of other
greens.  He is constantly restless, unwilling to settle down.  He
is large, but no larger than most dragons, which is to say, of course,
QUITE large.  If he was willing to talk to you (which he is not), he
could tell you about his extensive travels ...
Mobs.ActionScript: %%5 land;%5 fly

Objects.Name: hunting bow
Objects.Description:
Only a ranger who is master of his craft and pure of heart may wield
this mighty weapon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This item has been withdrawn as part of the transition to 2-handed
weapons. You should take this item to an Immortal who will load you
a new Great Hunting Bow, which will be 2-handed.
[Note for Imms: l o 6762]

Objects.Name: elven mithril chainmail
Objects.Description: A small pile of mithril has been abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Yet another example of fine elven craftsmanship, this chainmail was made
of purest mithril forged into thin, fine links which were then woven
tightly together.  The result is a magnificent piece of armor that is
light in weight but very strong.

Objects.Name: boots leather
Objects.Description:
Tough brown leather boots that lace to your knee stand waiting to be
worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These deep brown dragonskin boots are made to be laced tightly up 
your calf.  Of elven origin, they have been enchanted by the master
herbalist to last comfortably an entire elven life span.

Objects.Name: shield cap'n ranger buckler
Objects.Description:
A round buckler shield suitable for an active fighter is waiting to be
claimed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Fighting dragons means somehow staying shielded from their horrible
fiery breath, yet rangers need to be nimble and to move about easily in
the forest.  Not for them the heavy mighty battle shields of knights!
Instead, elven rangers use a small, round light shield made of mithril.
This one has been engraved with a slogan in tiny letters on the side
facing the enemy.
Remember! Only YOU can prevent forest fires!

Objects.Name: magical ball wildfire light
Objects.Description: A ball of wildfire throws with both warmth and light.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This magical ball will follow you wherever you go
illuminating your surroundings. The fire within the ball
burns wildly, barely controlled by the magic that locks 
it in place. Touch it carefully lest it scorch you!

Objects.Name: hunting knife master ranger
Objects.Description:
A sharp but strangely noble hunting knife waits for someone to take it
hunting.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Passed down from ranger generation to ranger generation, this knife is
one of the Master Ranger's most prized possessions.  Forged by
Horatio's great grandfather and scrupulously cared for by each
generation of ranger, the hunting knife is an invaluable tool for its
owner.

Objects.Name: tree
Objects.Description:
Henrietta's home is a massive ancient tree with rough deeply-furrowed
bark.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very ancient tree seems sentient, as if you could talk to it and
ask it questions.  It is covered with a very rough bark that is the
darkest shade of brown you have ever seen.

The tree bark is an unusually dark brown, with deep folds and sworls.
A bit above your head, the sworls form themselves into a deep knothole.

Objects.Name: leaves bunch
Objects.Description: The bunch of leaves is happy to be out of its knothole.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Just an ordinary bunch of leaves, very attached to their twig.
Although the twig is no longer attached to any tree, the leaves are
glossy and green and the twig is supple.

Objects.Name: twig key
Objects.Description: "I'm just an ordinary old twig," sings the twig.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: It looks like an ordinary old twig!

Objects.Name: dress henrietta
Objects.Description:
Henrietta's long black velvet dress is fastened by silver lacings that
pull it tight around her waist.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Henrietta likes to wear this long black velvet dress.  It is cut low
and square at the neck with silver lacings to cinch it tight around her
waist and long sleeves that come to a point over her hand.  The sleeve
edgings are trimmed in silver lace.

Objects.Name: Anastasia stuffed purple dragon
Objects.Description:
Annie's big stuffed purple dragon tries to look fierce.  It glows
reassuringly in the dark, its belly covered with stars.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The stuffed dragon is a well-loved child's toy and as she was growing
up Annie often staged mock battles with it.  Annie always won.  This
particular dragon is about 18" (45cm) tall, with a long tail dragging
behind her.  She has shiny light pink wings and a long, forked tongue.
Annie has named her Anastasia.

Objects.Name: socks purple
Objects.Description: Annie has carelessly left her purple socks on the floor.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These soft socks were hand-knitted from the finest of wool by Annie's
grandmother.  There is a faint pattern of stars glowing in the socks.

Objects.Name: star key
Objects.Description: A shining star the size of an elven thumb looks forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
About the size of a normal elven thumb, this star shape has a faint
glow about it.  It reminds you of something ...

Objects.Name: ancient elven ring
Objects.Description: The ancient elven ring holds many mysteries waiting to be discovered.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The ring is a wide circle of gold, deeply engraved.  On the outside of
the ring appears the symbol of the dragon, perhaps in memory of the
time dragons and elves fought together.  On the inside there is a
mysterious spell engraved in an ancient elven tongue and one is
reminded that the elves are the "first people".

Objects.Name: fire opal ring
Objects.Description: The small fire opal captured a lick of the dragon's fire.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: The fire opal on a ring of gold glows with the dragon's breath.

Objects.Name: sign
Objects.Description:
A small sign calls attention to itself by its bright colors of magenta
and lemon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: #mWatch out for #ylow flying #mdragons.

Objects.Name: wings gryphon fur feathers
Objects.Description:
Looking oddly out of place and unnaturally still, the combination of
fur and feathers wants to fly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Large strong wings in a golden auburn color properly belong to the
powerful gryphon.  Although the business part of the wing is covered
with long, sturdy feathers, the upper edge of the wing is covered with
a dense, thick mat of fur over sleek lithe muscles.  The wings combine
strength with agility and beauty.

Objects.Name: staff healing hawthorn heart
Objects.Description: A tall staff carved from the heart of the hawthorn obstructs your path.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Covered with runes and magical carvings, this staff has been carved
from the very heart of the witches' tree, the hawthorn.

Objects.Name: ornate gold ring
Objects.Description: An elaborately carved heavy gold ring looks too heavy to wear.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A very solid ring made from pure gold and forged by the gold dragon
himself.  He has deeply engraved it with his own likeness.  Dragons
tend to be a bit vain, and the gold dragon doesn't hesitate to remind
you that he has a heart of purest gold.  He uses this ring as a signet
ring, which means he presses it into sealing wax as his symbol.  He
never learned to write his name without singeing the paper.

Objects.Name: Chastity braided narrow belt leather
Objects.Description:
A narrow belt braided from many different leathers stretches out on
the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed of countless small threads of leather woven in an intricate
design to be sturdy and flexible, the belt is an excellent example of
elven craftsmanship.  The many different varieties of leather in the
belt add color and strength to the belt and the wearer.

Objects.Name: cloak shadow shadows
Objects.Description: Something almost unseen shadows the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Like a sudden mist, the cloak of shadows conceals without having any
substance of its own.  It is gray.  It is white.  It is black.  It is
without color or being, but with its folds it covers and warms and
protects.

Objects.Name: icicle
Objects.Description: A long, sharply pointed icicle chills the air around it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed by an evil mage cold to the marrow of his bones, this icicle
will never melt.  Its wicked point will slide easily into the heart of
your enemy.

Objects.Name: belt purple
Objects.Description: A l-o-n-g stripe of deepest purple ends in an elaborate silver buckle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The dark purple belt has been engraved with a pattern of dragons
frolicking joyfully.  The clasp at one end is made of silver.  The belt
is quite long.

Objects.Name: leg plates legplates
Objects.Description: These leg plates seem to glow with a faint bluish sheen.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The legplates on closer inspection are made of tiny overlapping slices
of pale blue aquamarine.  The crystal provides good protection against
normal weaponry, and is so beautiful it enhances the wearer's sense of
well-being.

Objects.Name: amethyst ankle bracelet chain
Objects.Description: Pale amethysts on a chain of gold glow quietly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Clear violet amethysts have been grouped together on a golden chain.
The amethysts vary greatly in size, shape and coloration.  At the
center of the chain is an enormous heart-shaped amethyst in a deep
purple color.

Objects.Name: cloak shiny white bundle
Objects.Description: A large bundle of white shines up at you, screaming, "Pick me up!"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The very long cloak reaches from your neck to your toes.  The heavy
shiny white substance forming the cloak has a strange rock-like feel to
it, yet the cloak floats gracefully with you as you walk or fight.

Objects.Name: armplates emerald scale green abandoned
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of emerald scale armplates
Objects.Description: Something very large and very green has evidently been abandoned.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed of thick, flat scales of solid deep green emerald, the armplates
are heavy armor, solid protection against attack.  Definitely good gear
for a fierce warrior!

Objects.Name: topaz bracelet circlet
Objects.Description: A circlet of topaz awaits its rightful owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A favorite item of the topaz dragon, I'm sure it will be missed by him.
The bracelet is a solid circle of glowing yellow topaz.  When it
catches the morning light the effect is nearly blinding.

Objects.Name: Crystal Trident
Objects.Description:
A short three pronged spear made of solid crystal is ready to attack
someone.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The crystal dragon formed this three-pronged spear from solid crystal.
The sharp, thin prongs of the trident will slide easily between the
ribs of its victim.  The crystal warms with use, enjoying its evil
purpose.  Put away, it gradually grows cold and brittle.

Objects.Name: glowing golden vial
Objects.Description: The small golden vial has a strange glow about it.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The vial feels warm to the touch.  When you enclose it in your palm, it
feels right, somehow.  The glow warms you.  There are no markings on
the vial to indicate what is inside, but you are reassured by the "HH"
engraved on the bottom.

Objects.Name: ruby scale shield
Objects.Description: The shield left lying on the ground glows with a ruby fire.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Formed from a large breast scale of the mighty ruby dragon, this shield
will protect you as it protected the dragon.  The deep red glow it
provides is almost warm enough to ward off a winter's chill.

Objects.Name: Bubbas tattered overalls
Objects.Description: Small tears and colorful patches cover the enormous overalls.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Bubba's favorite overalls look somewhat the worse for wear.  Bubba is
the largest of the baby dragons, and slightly embarassed about his
size.  He is very active, and the dragon master gave him these overalls
to provide some protection to his rapidly expanding dragon skin.  Bubba
has found that the patches seem to give him an added bounce to his
step.

Objects.Name: gnomish walking tunic
Objects.Description: A long leather walking tunic has been removed from its owner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A tough leather tunic favored by gnomish scientists for its many
pockets.  The gnomes stuff them with magnifying glasses, bits of string
and other stuff loved only by the gnomish.

Objects.Name: studly vest
Objects.Description: Unthinkable! Someone has left a very studly vest just lying around!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This is the vest every young (dragon) stud has to have!  Slip your arms
into it and let it hang loose.  This is the vest of your dreams!

Objects.Name: jackrabbit shoes
Objects.Description: A bit of grayish fur seems to be stuck to the shoes left here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jackrabbit has an amazingly powerful jump, and he owes some of this
kick to his specially made shoes.

Objects.Name: slippers sunshine
Objects.Description:
A pair of sunny yellow slippers with bright red smiley faces painted on
them are tucked neatly in a corner.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Sunshine is a very cute baby dragon and she is even cuter with these
little slippers on her baby dragon feet.  Swipe once stole them from
her to see if it would make her cry, but the dragon master made him
give them back.

Objects.Name: arm plates armplates mithril
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of mithril arm plates
Objects.Description: The shiny white glint of elven-forged mithril catches your eye.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These beautifully made armplates were a present to an elf on the
occasion of his heading out into the world on a Great Adventure.  They
were forged by Horatio, master of arms in Tynstri, and carefully marked
with protective runes by the elf's family.

Objects.Name: tattoo studly
Objects.Description:
A gold and silver tattoo of a sexy mud dragon could be burned into your
arm.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Tattoos are an "in" thing among this generation of dragon males.  This
one shows a very beautiful gold and silver female dragon. When properly
placed, when the young stud flexes the dragon appears to dance
seductively.

Objects.Name: potion nasty
Objects.Description: A really nasty looking potion in a grimy glass bottle sits undisturbed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Why is it that the stuff that's good for you always has to taste so
bad?  This is undoubtedly good for you, but feels really evil goin'
down.  This is a kind of lumpy pinkish goo.

Objects.Name: cureall cure-all potion
Objects.Description:
A cure-all potion struts around, proud as a peacock, but twice as
cheap.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This amazing little potion will cure your poison, cure your bellyache,
your headache, your fallen arches!  It will make the blind see again
and the cursed return to their normal state of grace.  And all for such
a paltry sum.

Objects.Name: runed bracers
Objects.Description: The heavily marked pair of bracers appears to hum to itself.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of a supple leather from some unknown beast, the bracers are
covered with runes.  Some have been stamped into the leather with some
metal tool, some burned in and some have been marked with ink.

Objects.Name: gentle death staff
Objects.Description: A highly polished black staff hovers gently above the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A smoothly polished black staff of volcanic glass sparkles with energy.
Obviously it WANTS to be used.

Objects.Name: sudden death wand
Objects.Description: A dark black wand attempts to fade into non-existence.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Made of black coal ripped from the earth by dragon fire, the wand will
twice perform it's evil task (murder most foul) before it may sink
back into the ground.

Objects.Name: fatal charm rod
Objects.Description:
A short rod of brilliant light glows in front of you, warming the
cockles of your heart.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Something about this beautiful wand just makes you feel good.  You want
to hold it close to you and never use it, lest it's warmth fade.

Objects.Name: black velvet slippers
Objects.ShortDescription: black velvet slippers with long pointy toes
Objects.Description:
Two slippers made of thick black velvet are sitting neatly side by
side.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Henrietta's slippers are made of a thick, strong velvet with a long nap
that needs to be brushed at least once a week.  The velvet is inlaid
with thin gold stripes, and the insides of the slippers have been
dusted with herbs (to combat foot odor).  In true wizard fashion, the
toes of these slippers appear to go on forever in a long graceful curl.

Objects.Name: gnomish walking stick
Objects.Description: A slightly crooked but sturdy stick lies in wait for you.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A rather short but sturdy stick for the adventurous gnome.  The smart
scientist pokes his stick into a strange hole first, rather than his
finger!  That's why most gnomes still have all 10 fingers in spite of
their many experiments and their adventurous research.

Objects.Name: bunch violets
Objects.Description: A sweet nosegay of violets is held together with a pretty white ribbon.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A small bunch of violets has been gathered and tied together with a
thin white satin ribbon.  The violets are a deep velvety purple color.

Objects.Name: bandana orange
Objects.Description: The orange bandana is so bright it practically shrieks, "PICK ME UP!"

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Young dragons are usually forced to wear soft pastel "baby" colors, and
by the time they reach adolescence they usually hate those colors and
long for the deep tones of adult dragons.  One group has chosen these
fiery orange bandanas as their symbol.

Objects.Name: bandana red scrap scarlet
Objects.Description: A small scrap of scarlet has been forgotten.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
There is a group of dragons who have banded together to stamp out
elves.  The elves are a threat to the continuation of dragonkind, they
reason, with their dragon-hunters and the bounty on dragonhides.  They
call themselves DragonFire, and wear the red bandana.

Objects.Name: box elf crackers
Objects.ShortDescription: a small box of elf crackers
Objects.Description:
Slightly sweet crackers shaped like elves fill a small brown box that
looks like a little tree.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Baby dragons love these little crackers.  Some are shaped like elf
wizards, some like monks.  They love to bite the head off the master
ranger, and chew each foot off of Henrietta Hennapy, one at a time 
to make her last.

Objects.Name: food candy jelly beans candies
Objects.Description: Some small egg-shaped brightly colored candies are scattered here.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The jellybeans look like tiny eggs from some exotic tropical bird.
They seem to come in an infinite variety of colors and flavors, but all
are extremely sweet.

Objects.Name: food cookies crumbs
Objects.Description: Some yummy oatmeal cookies look a bit crumbly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Before being mashed up in someone's pocket, these used to be very tasty
oatmeal cookies!

Objects.Name: leggings elvenkind
Objects.ShortDescription: a pair of leggings of elvenkind
Objects.Description: Someone has shed his leggings.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Thick leather leggings made for elven rangers must provide adequate
protection against the fierce predators that lurk in the forest, yet
not restrict a ranger's movements.  Rangers may need to climb trees,
race through underbrush, or perform other feats requiring great
agility.  These leggings were made with all of that in mind.

Objects.Name: armband silver snake ssnake sssilver
Objects.Description:
A sssapphire-eyed sssilver sssnake wantsss to wind itssself around 
your arm.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Out of the corner of your eye, you see a forked tongue slither 
quickly out of the snake's mouth.  The sapphire eye glitters.  Of
dwarven origin and craftmanship, you think, for the engraving and
delicate workmanship of this silver snake is very lifelike.

Objects.Name: girth forests
Objects.Description: The dragonhide girth has been fitted with a large brass buckle.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
An elven tanner took the thick skin of an emerald dragon and cured
it slowly, then shaped it into a wide girth and added a buckle
made of brass.

Objects.Name: garlic herb potion bulb
Objects.ShortDescription: a small white bulb of garlic
Objects.Description: A small white bulb of garlic might keep the vampires away!

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
This small, innocent looking herb conceals a very pungent scent when
eaten.  Perhaps this is the source of its legendary powers of keeping
villains at bay.

Objects.Name: dragoncrown crown gold
Objects.Description: A small, heavy crown glistens on the ground.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: A crown made only for dragon mobs.

Objects.Name: milk bota
Objects.Description: A bota made from well-cured dragonskin could hold a lot to drink.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The bota is a drink container, made for wine by the monks on the
hilltop monastery.  It is a graceful teardrop shape, soft and
capacious.  The rounded bottom tapers to a thin neck, closed with a
stopper which is attached to the body of the bota by a short cord.
This particular bota is made of dragon skin, which is particularly
thick and has insulating properties much needed by the dragons while
they are alive.  This skin shimmers with rainbow colors.

Objects.Name: trout food fish
Objects.Description: The brightly colored fish looks dipped in Heaven's colors.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The lovely fish looks very tasty as it slides through the cold waters
of the lake.  It swims, stripes of magenta, cyan, green and daffodil
adding color to the water.

Objects.Name: vulture eggs
Objects.Description:
The vulture's eggs are resting cozily in their little nest.  If the
eggs are here, surely their mother couldn't be far away.

ExtraDescriptions.Description: They are small and ovoid and contain baby vultures!  Leave them alone!

Objects.Name: peach-colored linen shirt
Objects.ShortDescription: a linen shirt the color of ripe peaches
Objects.Description:
Lying discarded here, you can see a finely woven linen shirt, soft as a
spring leaf.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The master weaver wove the linen making up this shirt from the finest,
softest flax.  It has been dyed the color of ripe peaches, and is very
soft to tender skin that rarely sees bright sunlight.

Objects.Name: oak staff
Objects.Description:
The sturdy oaken staff looks like a strong weapon that would also make
a good walking stick.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Cut from the heart of the mighty oak tree, this staff is perfect for
the nomadic druid or monk.

Objects.Name: forget-me-not flower scroll
Objects.Description:
The soft blue petals of the forget-me-not are the color of the sky on a
summer morning.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Jellie gives Flyn one of these flowers every morning so he'll always
have an easy way home.

Objects.Name: suede pants
Objects.Description:
Long, soft as silk but strong as any leather, this pair of suede pants
is waiting to be worn.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
These pants feel outrageously soft next to your skin, the slight fuzz
of the suede gives them a very sensuous feel.  You are reassured by the
fact that they are quite tough and very well made.  They are made to be
tucked into the tops of some knee-high boots.

Objects.Name: dragon crackers
Objects.Description:
A bright box of spicy dragon cookies lies in ambush, waiting for some
sucker to take a bite.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Rather spicy for a cookie, you need a strong stomach to swallow these
dragon crackers.  They are quite colorful, as are the dragons they
imitate.  There is something written on the box in tiny print.
Made especially for the elves by the dragons of Tynstri.

Objects.Name: dragon egg eggs
Objects.Description: A very large jewel-bright egg glows.  What will it hatch?

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
Some dragon has chosen to leave a precious egg here.  Dragon eggs 
come in many hues, but all are deep, rich, jewel tones.  Although
they take a long time to hatch, there is no way to tell (from the
outside) how soon this egg will crack.  Of course, the fact that it
seems to be rocking itself might give you a clue that whatever is 
inside is pretty big!
